                                                        Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Orzo

                                                        https://hungryhappens.net/creamy-mushroom-and-spinach-orzo/

                                                        A one-pan creamy orzo with browned mushrooms and spinach that tastes like a gourmet risotto. Serves 4 (prep 5 min, cook 35 min).

                                                        Orzo

                                                        • 2 tbsp olive oil, divided
                                                        • 1 lb baby bella mushrooms, sliced
                                                        • salt and pepper, to taste
                                                        • 2 tbsp salted butter, divided
                                                        • 1 medium onion, fine dice
                                                        • 3 cloves garlic, minced
                                                        • 2 cups uncooked orzo pasta
                                                        • 3 3/4 cups low-sodium chicken broth, room temperature
                                                        • 1/2 cup heavy cream, room temperature
                                                        • 1/2 cup milk, room temperature
                                                        • 1 tsp Italian herb seasoning
                                                        • salt + pepper, to taste
                                                        • 1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
                                                        • 4 oz baby spinach, rough chop
                                                        • 1/4 cup fresh parsley, chopped

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Add 1 tbsp olive oil to a large deep skillet. Saute the mushrooms in two batches (each with 1 tbsp olive oil), about 5 minutes each batch. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Transfer browned mushrooms to a plate and set aside.
                                                        2. Add 1 tbsp of butter to the pan and the onion. Saute for 2-3 minutes, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds. Stir in the orzo for 1 minute. Add the mushrooms back to the pan along with the broth, heavy cream, milk, herb blend seasoning and salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to a simmer. Stir constantly until the orzo is cooked through al dente.
                                                        3. Remove from heat and stir in the remaining 1 tbsp of butter and the grated parmesan. Fold in the spinach and parsley. Serve with extra parmesan or parsley.

                                                        From the creator's website: the broth and cream must be at room temperature when added, or the cream will curdle.

                                                        Spicy Spinach Mushroom Pasta

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        A creamy one-pot pasta with browned mushrooms, garlicky spinach and mozzarella on top.

                                                        Pasta and mushrooms

                                                        • 10 oz pasta
                                                        • 20 oz chopped mushrooms (creator used white and oyster mushrooms)
                                                        • 3 garlic, minced
                                                        • 1/2 jalapeno, chopped
                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon salt, black pepper, paprika or cayenne, turmeric

                                                        Spinach

                                                        • 1 tablespoon olive oil
                                                        • 1/2 onion, diced
                                                        • 4 garlic, minced
                                                        • 2 handfuls spinach

                                                        Sauce

                                                        • 2 tablespoons butter
                                                        • 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
                                                        • 8 oz milk (creator used whole milk)
                                                        • 8 oz broth
                                                        • 2 cups (16 oz) heavy whipping cream
                                                        • 1/4 cup parmesan cheese (caption reads '1/4 Parmesan cheese')
                                                        • 1-2 cups mozzarella cheese

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Cook pasta in salt water - al dente, don't overcook.
                                                        2. Cook mushrooms in butter; after 5-6 minutes, when the mushrooms are cooked and browning, add the garlic, jalapeno and seasoning, then remove.
                                                        3. Saute the onion, garlic and spinach in olive oil. Cook 1-2 min, then remove.
                                                        4. Add the butter and flour on low-medium heat; whisk the flour until brown, 1-2 minutes. Slowly add the milk and broth. Sprinkle in the parmesan. Add the spinach and heavy whipping cream. Cook until it starts to thicken.
                                                        5. Adjust salt and pepper.
                                                        6. Add the pasta, top with the mushrooms and lots of mozzarella.
                                                        7. Cover with the lid. Optional: drizzle chili oil and chili flakes.

                                                        Milk Chocolate Honeycomb Bon Bons

                                                        https://www.donnahay.com.au/recipes/desserts-and-baking/milk-chocolate-honeycomb-bon-bons

                                                        Crisp shards of homemade honeycomb drizzled with milk chocolate - a festive, giftable treat. Serves 10-12.

                                                        Honeycomb and chocolate

                                                        • 1/4 cup (60ml) water
                                                        • 300g caster (superfine) sugar
                                                        • 2 tablespoons honey
                                                        • 180g glucose syrup
                                                        • 1 tablespoon bicarbonate of soda, sifted
                                                        • 270g milk chocolate, melted

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Line a 20cm x 30cm deep baking tray with non-stick baking paper.
                                                        2. Combine the water, sugar, honey and glucose in a large heavy-based saucepan. Place over low heat and stir, without boiling, until all the sugar has dissolved.
                                                        3. Increase the heat to medium and bring to a boil. Add a sugar (candy) thermometer and cook until the temperature reaches 148C (298F).
                                                        4. Remove from the heat and, working quickly, whisk in the bicarbonate of soda until well combined. Immediately pour the mixture into the prepared tray. Allow to cool and harden in a cool dry place. Do not refrigerate.
                                                        5. Cut into large shards and place on non-stick baking paper. Drizzle the tops of the honeycomb with the chocolate and allow to cool.
                                                        6. Store in an airtight container. To give as a gift, wrap in sheets of non-stick baking paper and tie the ends with string or ribbon.

                                                        From the creator's website (the reel caption itself only points to the website). The creator's cook's tip: once the sugar has dissolved, do not stir while the temperature rises, and keep the thermometer off the base of the pan.

                                                        Amma's Style Easy Peasy Chicken Dum Biriyani

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        A home-style one-pot chicken dum biryani with a fresh coriander-chilli paste and whole spices.

                                                        Paste

                                                        • 1 cup coriander leaves
                                                        • 6-7 green chillies

                                                        Masala

                                                        • oil, for cooking
                                                        • 1 bay leaf
                                                        • 2 cloves
                                                        • 2 small cinnamon sticks
                                                        • 2 cardamom
                                                        • 1 star anise
                                                        • 2 marati moggu (kapok buds)
                                                        • 1 small japatre (nutmeg mace)
                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon shahi jeera
                                                        • 1 tablespoon fennel seeds
                                                        • 1 medium onion, chopped
                                                        • 2 tablespoons ginger garlic paste
                                                        • 1 cup mint leaves
                                                        • 1 tablespoon kasuri methi
                                                        • 1 cup chopped tomato
                                                        • 1/2 kg chicken
                                                        • salt as needed
                                                        • 1 tablespoon garam masala powder

                                                        Rice

                                                        • 2 cups sona masoori rice
                                                        • 3.5 cups water
                                                        • 1 tablespoon lemon juice

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Grind the coriander leaves and green chillies into a paste.
                                                        2. In a pan with oil, cook the whole spices briefly.
                                                        3. Add the chopped onion and fry until golden brown.
                                                        4. Add the ginger garlic paste and cook for about 2 minutes, then add the mint leaves and kasuri methi.
                                                        5. Add the chopped tomato and cook until the tomatoes are mushy.
                                                        6. Add the paste together with the chicken, salt as needed and the garam masala powder. Close the lid and cook the chicken for 10 minutes.
                                                        7. Once the chicken is cooked, add water as needed for the rice (2 cups of sona masoori rice needs 3.5 cups of water).
                                                        8. Add the lemon juice at the end and either keep it on dum at low flame for 20 minutes, or pressure cook for two whistles.
                                                        9. Serve hot with raita.

                                                        Chai Tiramisu with Cake Rusks

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        A Diwali dessert crossing tiramisu, tres leches, and chai — cake rusks soaked in extra-strong chai and layered with a saffron cream, inspired by @dish_by_rish's eggless chai tiramisu idea.

                                                        Chai Soak

                                                        • 10 tea bags
                                                        • 30g ginger
                                                        • 15 cardamom pods
                                                        • 1/2 tsp black pepper
                                                        • 4 cloves
                                                        • 1 cinnamon stick
                                                        • 1 litre water (reduced by half during cooking)
                                                        • 150ml evaporated milk
                                                        • 75g white sugar

                                                        Saffron Cream

                                                        • 250g mascarpone cheese
                                                        • 250g cream cheese (or mascarpone)
                                                        • 4 eggs
                                                        • 100g granulated sugar
                                                        • A large pinch saffron
                                                        • 2 ice cubes

                                                        Assembly

                                                        • 24 cake rusks or tiramisu lady fingers
                                                        • 100g pistachios, finely chopped

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. First make the extra strong chai: bash up the spices in a pestle and mortar just until crushed. Add to a large pot with the tea bags and 1 litre of water. Cook on high for 20 mins with the lid off; it should reduce by half.
                                                        2. Add the evaporated milk and sugar and continue cooking for 10 mins. Allow to cool completely in the pan and then strain — you want about 600ml of liquid; top up with more evaporated milk or water if needed.
                                                        3. Meanwhile, grind the saffron with 1 tsp of the sugar, add a couple of ice cubes and let melt at room temperature.
                                                        4. Separate the whites and the yolks. In a clean bowl whisk the whites with half the sugar until you get stiff peaks.
                                                        5. Whisk the yolks with the remaining sugar until pale and thick — to the ribbon stage. Add in the mascarpone and cream cheese and continue to beat until thick and creamy. Add in the melted saffron and mix well.

                                                        Steps in the caption are truncated (it cuts off at "Using a spatula fold in half of the egg w…"), so the remaining assembly steps are not included; ingredients are transcribed in full.

                                                        Creamy Tomato Garlic Pasta

                                                        Transcribed from majasrecipes.com/easy-and-creamy-tomato-garlic-pasta-recipe

                                                        Pasta

                                                        • 8 garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 3 cups cherry tomatoes, halved
                                                        • 4 Tbsp olive oil
                                                        • 1 cup dry white wine
                                                        • 1 tsp white sugar
                                                        • 1 tsp chili flakes
                                                        • 2 Tbsp tomato paste
                                                        • 2 cups heavy cream
                                                        • 1 Tbsp flour
                                                        • 1/2 cup chopped parsley
                                                        • 8 oz rigatoni pasta, cooked al dente
                                                        • 1 tsp smoked paprika
                                                        • 1 tsp garlic powder
                                                        • Salt and pepper to taste
                                                        • Freshly grated Parmesan (optional)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Mince the garlic and halve the cherry tomatoes.
                                                        2. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat; saute the garlic with a pinch of salt about 1 minute until fragrant (don't brown it).
                                                        3. Add the cherry tomatoes and another 1/2 tsp salt; saute 10-15 minutes until softened and releasing their juices.
                                                        4. Deglaze with the white wine and simmer about 5 minutes; stir in the chili flakes and tomato paste.
                                                        5. Pour in the heavy cream. Whisk the flour with 2 Tbsp water into a slurry, stir it in slowly, and cook 5-10 minutes to thicken. Add the sugar to balance acidity.
                                                        6. Stir in the parsley, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper; add the cooked rigatoni (kept al dente).
                                                        7. Simmer 5 minutes in the sauce, then rest covered 5 minutes.
                                                        8. Serve garnished with Parmesan, extra parsley and black pepper.

                                                        Butter Chicken Lasagna

                                                        Transcribed from thegoldenbalance.com

                                                        Chicken Marinade

                                                        • 2 lb chicken thighs, cut into bite-size cubes
                                                        • 3/4 cup yogurt
                                                        • 3 Tbsp ginger garlic paste
                                                        • 2 tsp garam masala
                                                        • 1 tsp turmeric
                                                        • 1 tsp kashmiri chili powder
                                                        • 1 tsp salt
                                                        • 1 Tbsp olive oil

                                                        Sauce

                                                        • 2 Tbsp ghee, divided
                                                        • 2 medium onions, thinly sliced
                                                        • 1 Tbsp tomato paste
                                                        • 1 Tbsp ginger garlic paste
                                                        • 1/2 tsp garam masala
                                                        • 1/4 tsp turmeric
                                                        • 1/4 tsp kashmiri chili powder
                                                        • 1/2 cup cashews
                                                        • 1 (14 oz) can tomato sauce
                                                        • 1 cup heavy cream
                                                        • 3 Tbsp butter

                                                        To Assemble

                                                        • 2 cups shredded mozzarella
                                                        • 1 lb dried lasagna sheets
                                                        • Dried fenugreek leaves for garnish

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Toss the cubed chicken with the yogurt, ginger garlic paste, garam masala, turmeric, kashmiri chili powder, olive oil and salt; marinate 15-30 minutes.
                                                        2. Sear the chicken in melted ghee over medium-high heat until golden and just cooked, 6-7 minutes. Remove to a bowl.
                                                        3. In the same pan, cook the onions and tomato paste 1-2 minutes, then add the ginger garlic paste, spices and cashews; toast 2-3 more minutes. Add the tomato sauce and simmer on low 5 minutes.
                                                        4. Off the heat, cool 5 minutes, then blend until smooth. Return to the pan over medium-low; stir in the heavy cream and butter until thick and creamy, 3-5 minutes. Fold the chicken back in.
                                                        5. Grease a 9x13 baking dish. Layer: 1/4 of the chicken and sauce, a layer of lasagna sheets, 1/4 of the mozzarella. Repeat until everything is used.
                                                        6. Bake at 350 F for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Rest briefly, garnish with fenugreek leaves, and serve.

                                                        Harissa Glazed Roast Potatoes

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Crispy, fluffy roast potatoes in a sweet and spicy harissa glaze, served over silky smooth yoghurt. Serves 5.

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Peel the potatoes and halve or quarter any large ones. Add to a large saucepan of cold water, bring to a boil, and boil 7-8 minutes until soft on the outside. Drain, return to the saucepan, shake to fluff the outsides, and leave to cool 10-15 minutes.
                                                        2. Add a generous glug of olive oil to a roasting tray and place it in the oven; preheat the oven to 200°C fan / 425°F.
                                                        3. Drop the par-boiled potatoes onto the hot oil, sprinkle with a generous pinch of salt, and mix. Roast 45-55 minutes until golden and crispy, turning halfway.
                                                        4. When the potatoes are nearly ready, add a splash of olive oil to a large pan on medium heat. Add the garlic and cook 1-2 minutes until it begins to turn golden. Stir in the harissa paste and maple syrup and cook 2-3 minutes until the sauce begins to thicken.
                                                        5. Add the roast potatoes to the pan and stir into the harissa glaze until all are covered, then remove from the heat.
                                                        6. To serve, spoon the yoghurt over a large serving plate. Top with the harissa glazed roast potatoes, then the coriander leaves and a big pinch of salt. Drizzle over any sauce left in the pan and squeeze over juice from the lemon wedges.

                                                        Trader Joe's Tomato Burrata Ravioloni with Spicy Vodka Sauce

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Spicy Vodka Sauce

                                                        • 3 tbsp salted butter
                                                        • 1 tbsp olive oil
                                                        • 3 cloves garlic, minced
                                                        • 1/3 cup tomato paste
                                                        • 1 tsp Calabrian chili paste (or 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes)
                                                        • 1 shot vodka
                                                        • 3/4 cup heavy cream
                                                        • 1 hefty pinch sugar
                                                        • pinch of salt
                                                        • 1 cup grated parmesan, divided

                                                        Pasta & Topping

                                                        • 2 (8.8 oz) boxes Trader Joe's Tomato & Burrata Ravioloni
                                                        • 2 balls fresh burrata
                                                        • Kosher salt

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
                                                        2. Melt butter and olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add garlic and cook, stirring often, until soft and fragrant but not browned.
                                                        3. Add tomato paste and Calabrian chili paste; stir until incorporated and the tomato paste has darkened slightly, 3–4 minutes.
                                                        4. Add the vodka and stir vigorously for 2–3 minutes until the pan is deglazed and the sauce comes together.
                                                        5. Turn the heat to medium-low and add the heavy cream, stirring to incorporate. Simmer on low for 3 minutes, then add a hefty pinch of sugar, a pinch of salt, and 1/2 cup of the grated parmesan; stir until melted. Reduce to low and simmer.
                                                        6. Cook the ravioli in the boiling water for 2 minutes, until it starts to float and puff up slightly. Reserve a cup of pasta water, then strain.
                                                        7. Add the ravioli to the sauce with 1/2 cup of pasta water; stir until smooth and creamy, adding more pasta water little by little over medium-low heat until silky.
                                                        8. Plate, break the burrata into pieces over the ravioli, and finish with a sprinkle of salt, pepper, and the remaining parmesan for serving.

                                                        Crispy Smashed Potato Salad

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Potatoes

                                                        • 750g baby new potatoes
                                                        • 1 tbsp chicken seasoning
                                                        • 1 tbsp piri piri seasoning (or smoked paprika + garlic powder)
                                                        • Olive oil
                                                        • Salt
                                                        • Pepper

                                                        Dressing

                                                        • 3 tbsp mayo
                                                        • 3 tbsp Greek-style yoghurt
                                                        • 1 lemon (juice)
                                                        • 1 garlic clove
                                                        • 2 tbsp each pickled gherkins, cucumber, red onion, chives and dill

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Place the potatoes in a pot of cold salted water, bring to a boil, then simmer until fork tender (25–30 minutes). Preheat the oven to 200°C.
                                                        2. Make the dressing: combine mayo, yoghurt, lemon juice and garlic in a mixing bowl, then add the finely diced gherkins, cucumber, onion, chives and dill. Mix well, season to taste with salt and pepper, and chill until serving.
                                                        3. Once fork tender, steam-dry the potatoes, place them on a large lined baking tray, and flatten with the bottom of a glass without overcrowding.
                                                        4. Sprinkle with the seasonings and drizzle generously with olive oil. Roast for 30–45 minutes, turning halfway, until completely crisp and golden.
                                                        5. Let the potatoes cool, then spoon half the dressing into a large mixing bowl, add the potatoes, and toss gently to coat. Add more dressing as needed, finish with fresh herbs, and serve.

                                                        • 1 cup milk
                                                        • 2 tbsp cocoa powder
                                                        • 1 tbsp maple syrup or honey

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Whisk the milk, chia seeds, cocoa and sweetener until fully combined, then let it set in the fridge for 15–20 minutes until thickened.
                                                        2. Add the thickened mixture to a blender and blend on high until smooth and creamy.
                                                        3. Return to the container and let it set overnight — it gets better the longer it sits.

                                                        Travel-Friendly Methi Theplas

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Theplas

                                                        • 2 cups whole wheat flour
                                                        • 1/4 cup besan (gram flour)
                                                        • 1 tsp turmeric powder
                                                        • 1.5 tsp red chilli powder
                                                        • 1.5 tsp coriander powder
                                                        • 1.5 tbsp garlic-chilli paste
                                                        • Salt to taste
                                                        • 1/2 tsp crushed carom seeds (ajwain)
                                                        • 1 tbsp sesame seeds
                                                        • 1.5 tbsp oil
                                                        • 1/2 to 3/4 cup fresh methi leaves, chopped (or frozen, crushed)
                                                        • 1/3 cup yogurt
                                                        • Water as needed (1/2 to 3/4 cup)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. In a bowl, mix the whole wheat flour, besan, turmeric, red chilli powder, coriander powder, garlic-chilli paste, salt, crushed carom seeds and sesame seeds.
                                                        2. Add the methi leaves, yogurt and oil; mix well.
                                                        3. Gradually add water, kneading to form a smooth dough.
                                                        4. Divide the dough into balls, roll into thin circles, and sprinkle sesame seeds halfway through rolling.
                                                        5. Heat a tava or skillet over medium heat; cook each thepla for 1–2 minutes per side, adding oil or ghee, until golden brown.
                                                        6. To keep theplas fresh for travel: cool completely, wrap the stack in paper towel, then tightly in foil, then in an airtight container or resealable bag. Refrigerate at the destination if using within a few days.

                                                        Loaded Baked Potato Soup

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Soup

                                                        • 3 potatoes (baked)
                                                        • 6 slices bacon
                                                        • 4 tbsp butter
                                                        • 2 cloves garlic
                                                        • 1/4 cup yellow onion
                                                        • 1/3 cup flour
                                                        • 2 cups low-fat milk
                                                        • 1 cup half and half
                                                        • 2 cups chicken broth
                                                        • 1 tsp salt
                                                        • 1/2 tsp pepper and garlic powder
                                                        • 2 cups shredded cheddar
                                                        • 1 cup sour cream

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Bake the potatoes at 400°F for 1 hour; halve and scoop out the flesh into a bowl.
                                                        2. Fry the bacon and chop into bits.
                                                        3. In a pot, heat 1 tbsp of the bacon grease with the butter; cook the chopped onion for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic and flour, stirring to eliminate clumps, for 1 minute.
                                                        4. Slowly stir in the milk and half and half, then the chicken broth. Add the salt, pepper and garlic powder; bring to a simmer for 5 minutes.
                                                        5. Reduce the heat; add the bacon and cheddar and stir until melted, then add back the potato flesh and heat for a few minutes.
                                                        6. Serve in bowls topped with sour cream, extra cheese, bacon and green onion.

                                                        Channa Masala

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Spiced chickpea curry with ginger, mango powder, chilli and coriander; comfort food for a Sunday lunch.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 240 gms tinned chickpeas
                                                        • 3 tbsp ghee or vegetable oil
                                                        • 3 green cardamom pods
                                                        • 180 gms white onions, blended to a paste
                                                        • 4 garlic cloves, crushed to a paste
                                                        • 2" ginger, thinly sliced in matchsticks
                                                        • 1 tsp cumin powder
                                                        • 1 tsp coriander powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder
                                                        • 1 tsp mango powder / amchoor
                                                        • 90 gms chopped tomato
                                                        • 1 tbsp tomato puree
                                                        • 1 tsp caster sugar
                                                        • 150 mls water or veg stock
                                                        • Salt, to taste
                                                        • Fresh coriander, for garnish

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Drain the chickpeas and set aside.
                                                        2. Heat the oil in a heavy bottom saucepan, add cardamom pods and let them sizzle. Fry the onions for 7-8 minutes as they soften.
                                                        3. Add crushed garlic and most of the ginger (saving some to garnish). Fry, then add the powdered spices.
                                                        4. Tip in the tomatoes and tomato puree. Fry for 5 minutes, mashing lightly with the back of a spoon.
                                                        5. Add the chickpeas and fry for 4-5 minutes as the masala coats them. Add the stock or water, sugar and season to taste.
                                                        6. Simmer and cook with the lid on for 20-25 minutes, stirring halfway through.
                                                        7. Garnish with fresh coriander and ginger. Serve with parathas or puris.

                                                        Vegan Churros with Chocolate Sauce

                                                        Transcribed from zhangcatherine.com (the creator's linked recipe page)

                                                        Crunchy vegan churros fried golden-brown and rolled in cinnamon sugar, with a bittersweet chocolate sauce — egg-free like Spanish street-vendor churros, so they stay shatteringly crisp outside and soft inside. Makes 4 servings.

                                                        Churro Dough

                                                        • 140 ml water (1/2 cup + 1 tbsp)
                                                        • 13 g granulated sugar (1 tbsp)
                                                        • 30 ml vegetable oil (2 tbsp)
                                                        • 120 g all-purpose flour (1 cup)
                                                        • 1/4 tsp salt

                                                        Cinnamon Sugar

                                                        • 100 g granulated sugar (1/2 cup)
                                                        • 2 tsp ground cinnamon

                                                        Chocolate Sauce

                                                        • 100 g semi-sweet chocolate, vegan or regular (3.5 oz)
                                                        • 60 ml non-dairy milk or regular milk (1/4 cup)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. In a medium saucepan, combine the water, oil and sugar over medium-high heat and bring to a boil.
                                                        2. Remove from the heat and add the flour to the water mixture all at once; stir until it forms a ball of dough.
                                                        3. Let the dough cool 15-20 minutes, then transfer to a piping bag fitted with a large star tip.
                                                        4. Heat a deep fryer or heavy-bottomed pan of vegetable oil to 190C/375F (a dropped piece of dough should bubble and float). Combine the sugar and cinnamon in a shallow bowl.
                                                        5. Pipe pieces of dough into the hot oil (cut with scissors to drop them in); fry 2-3 churros at a time for 2-3 minutes until golden brown.
                                                        6. Drain on a paper towel or wire rack, then toss in the cinnamon sugar while still warm. Repeat until all are fried.
                                                        7. For the chocolate sauce: finely chop the chocolate and place in a heatproof bowl; heat the milk, pour over the chocolate, sit 5 minutes and stir until completely melted. Serve with the warm churros.

                                                        Oven-Baked Crispy Parmesan Chicken

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Crispy fried chicken fillets baked under marinara and two cheeses — 'baked chicken' with a golden, bubbling finish.

                                                        Chicken & Marinade

                                                        • 3 large chicken breasts, halved horizontally to make 6 fillets
                                                        • Salt, to taste
                                                        • 1 tbsp black pepper
                                                        • 1 tsp paprika powder
                                                        • 1 tbsp freshly minced garlic

                                                        Frying & Topping

                                                        • 2 eggs
                                                        • 1/2 cup breadcrumbs
                                                        • 1/2 cup oil, for frying
                                                        • 1/2 cup marinara sauce
                                                        • 2 jalapeno peppers (optional)
                                                        • 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese
                                                        • 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese
                                                        • Basil, for garnish

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Preheat the oven to 400F. Wash and pat dry the chicken fillets and marinate them with salt, pepper, paprika powder and garlic. Cover and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
                                                        2. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot and shimmering. Fry the chicken until golden and crispy, about 4-5 minutes each side.
                                                        3. Place the chicken on a prepared baking tray/dish and top each breast with marinara sauce and jalapenos. Top each with mozzarella and about 2 tablespoons Parmesan; sprinkle with basil.

                                                        Tiramisu Cake

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A make-ahead tiramisu cake — ladyfingers layered with rum-spiked mascarpone, finished in a springform pan and dusted with cacao.

                                                        Tiramisu Mixture

                                                        • 3 large egg yolks
                                                        • 1/2 cup sugar
                                                        • 2 tubs 8oz mascarpone cheese, cold
                                                        • 1 cup heavy whipping cream, cold
                                                        • 2 tbs rum
                                                        • Unsweetened cacao powder, for dusting

                                                        Assembly

                                                        • 15 lady fingers
                                                        • 1/2 cup espresso
                                                        • 1 tbs rum (for the espresso)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Brew the espresso and set it aside.
                                                        2. Whisk the egg yolks with the sugar over a water bath at medium-low temperature until fluffy and the sugar has melted (about 7 minutes).
                                                        3. Whip the cold heavy cream until stiff peaks (whip slowly to keep it stable longer — start low, increase to medium).
                                                        4. Whip the cold mascarpone with 2 tbs rum, add the egg mixture and mix, then gently fold in the whipped cream.
                                                        5. Add 1 tbs rum to the espresso. Dip the lady fingers and layer with the tiramisu mixture in a 7-inch springform; repeat 3 times, reserving some tiramisu mixture in a piping bag to decorate the cake.
                                                        6. Cover and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight. Dust with cacao before serving.
                                                        View reel

                                                        Ham and Swiss Puff Pastries

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Quick ham and cheese puff pastry pockets with Dijon mustard and everything-bagel seasoning — a snack, app or quick breakfast treat.

                                                        Main

                                                        • 2 tbsp Dijon mustard
                                                        • 5 ham slices, any kind
                                                        • 5 Swiss cheese slices or Cheddar cheese slices
                                                        • 1 sheet puff pastry
                                                        • Egg wash
                                                        • Everything Bagel seasoning or sesame seeds

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees and line a cookie sheet with parchment paper.
                                                        2. Unroll the puff pastry and roll out the dough to thin and flatten it.
                                                        3. Cut the sheet of pastry into 9 equal rectangles and place on the prepared cookie sheet.
                                                        4. Add about 1/2 teaspoon of Dijon mustard to each pastry rectangle (more if you like).
                                                        5. Cut the cheese slices in half, then cut the halves lengthwise again into strips; do the same with the ham slices.
                                                        6. Layer the cheese then the ham over the Dijon mustard.
                                                        7. Wet the inside of one edge of the pastry with egg wash; fold the dry edge over the ham and cheese, then place the wet edge over the top. Press lightly to seal.
                                                        8. Brush the tops with egg wash and sprinkle with Everything Bagel seasoning or sesame seeds.
                                                        9. Bake 25-28 minutes until lightly golden. Cool on the cookie sheet 2-3 minutes, then serve.

                                                        Creme Brulee

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Classic creme brulee baked in a 300F water bath and torched to order — the creator's week-1 dessert, nailed on the first try.

                                                        Custard

                                                        • 6 egg yolks (at room temperature)
                                                        • 1/2 cup sugar
                                                        • 2 cups heavy cream
                                                        • 1 whole vanilla bean (or vanilla extract after heating)

                                                        Topping

                                                        • Powdered sugar, to dust

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Preheat the oven to 300F.
                                                        2. Whisk the 6 room-temperature egg yolks with 1/2 cup sugar until thick and creamy.
                                                        3. Heat 2 cups heavy cream in a saucepan with the whole vanilla bean over low heat until just hot. Remove the vanilla bean, turn off the stove and let it sit for 7 minutes. (If using vanilla extract, add it after removing the cream from the heat.)
                                                        4. Pour the cream into the egg yolk and sugar mixture; mix well without over-mixing.
                                                        5. Strain the liquid and pour into ramekins (4oz ramekins). Place them in an oven tray and add hot water.
                                                        6. Bake at 300F for 45 minutes, or until the custard is fully set.
                                                        7. Cool at room temperature, then refrigerate overnight or at least four hours.
                                                        8. Right before serving, dust with powdered sugar and melt with a kitchen torch until caramelized.

                                                        Spinach & Cheese Ravioli

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A 'fancy dinner' homemade spinach and cheese ravioli in a Mamma Rosa sauce — eggless, restaurant-style. Tips: rest the dough 45 minutes, keep the filling at room temperature, and serve it hot.

                                                        Pasta Dough

                                                        • 1/2 cup Barik Rawa
                                                        • 1/2 cup all purpose flour or whole wheat flour
                                                        • A little salt
                                                        • Hot water, for the dough

                                                        Filling

                                                        • 2 tsp butter
                                                        • 8 to 10 cloves garlic
                                                        • 1 medium sized onion
                                                        • 2 big bowls chopped spinach
                                                        • 1/2 cup crumbled paneer
                                                        • 1/4 cup grated cheese
                                                        • Salt & pepper
                                                        • Chilli flakes & oregano

                                                        Mamma Rosa Sauce

                                                        • 1 cup white sauce
                                                        • 1/2 cup pasta sauce (the creator's pizza pasta sauce)
                                                        • Some cheese

                                                        To Finish

                                                        • Some butter, parsley and chilli flakes, to saute the ravioli
                                                        • Basil leaves & chilli oil, for garnish

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Make the pasta dough with the rawa, flour, salt and hot water. Rest it for at least 45 minutes so it is soft and pliable.
                                                        2. For the filling: saute the garlic, onion and spinach in butter, then mix with the crumbled paneer, grated cheese, salt, pepper, chilli flakes and oregano. Let the filling come to room temperature.
                                                        3. Roll out the dough, fill and seal the ravioli well.
                                                        4. Add the ravioli to the water only when it is boiling and bubbling; cook until done.
                                                        5. For the Mamma Rosa sauce: combine the white sauce, pasta sauce and cheese.
                                                        6. Saute the cooked ravioli in butter with parsley and chilli flakes; plate with the Mamma Rosa sauce and garnish with basil leaves and chilli oil. Serve hot.

                                                        Pulissery (Kerala Yogurt Curry)

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        An easy pulissery — the Kerala yogurt curry the creator says he could have 24x7 — with shallots, garlic and ginger in a coconut-oil tempering, finished with a red chilli oil.

                                                        Main

                                                        • 1 handful shallots
                                                        • 1/2 a pot of garlic
                                                        • 1 inch ginger
                                                        • 1 packet curd (preferably Milky Mist)
                                                        • 4-5 dried red chillies
                                                        • Some curry leaves

                                                        Tempering

                                                        • Coconut oil
                                                        • Mustard seeds
                                                        • Fenugreek seeds
                                                        • 1/2 tsp turmeric powder

                                                        Chilli Oil

                                                        • 1 tbsp coconut oil
                                                        • Chilli powder

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Chop together a handful of shallots, half a pot of garlic and an inch of ginger. Keep aside 4-5 dried red chillies and some curry leaves.
                                                        2. Add 1 packet of curd (preferably Milky Mist) to a mixer grinder and grind for just 3 seconds — do not make it watery. Set aside.
                                                        3. Heat coconut oil in a pan; splutter mustard and fenugreek seeds.
                                                        4. Add the red chillies. When their colour starts changing, add the ginger, garlic, shallots and curry leaves.
                                                        5. Add 1/2 tsp turmeric powder and mix well. Turn off the gas before the curry boils — continue mixing so it does not boil.

                                                        Black Pepper Chicken

                                                        A quick, family-favourite stir fry — chicken velveted in soy and cornstarch, tossed with bell peppers, onion and a glossy black-pepper sauce. Served over white rice.

                                                        Chicken marinade

                                                        • 1 lb (450 g) chicken breasts or thighs, sliced against the grain into 1/4-inch pieces
                                                        • 1 tbsp light soy sauce
                                                        • 1 tbsp Shaoxing wine (or dry sherry)
                                                        • 1 tbsp cornstarch

                                                        Sauce

                                                        • 1/2 cup chicken broth
                                                        • 2 tbsp light soy sauce
                                                        • 2 tbsp Shaoxing wine (or dry sherry)
                                                        • 2 tsp dark soy sauce
                                                        • 1 tbsp cornstarch
                                                        • 1 1/2 tbsp sugar
                                                        • 2 tsp coarsely ground black pepper
                                                        • 1/8 tsp salt

                                                        Stir fry

                                                        • 2 tbsp peanut or vegetable oil
                                                        • 1 tbsp minced ginger
                                                        • 2 cloves garlic, minced
                                                        • 1/2 white onion, chopped
                                                        • 2 bell peppers, chopped

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Combine the chicken with the marinade and set aside.
                                                        2. Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside.
                                                        3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on both sides but still a bit pink inside. Transfer to a plate.
                                                        4. Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil, then the ginger, garlic and vegetables.
                                                        5. Stir the sauce until the cornstarch is fully dissolved, pour into the skillet and stir immediately; cook a few seconds until it thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon.
                                                        6. Add the chicken back, toss to coat, then remove from the heat and transfer everything to a big plate so it stops cooking. Serve over white rice.

                                                        Creamy Garlic Chicken

                                                        https://carlsbadcravings.com/wprm_print/creamy-garlic-chicken

                                                        Golden, lightly breaded chicken cutlets simmered in a luxurious Parmesan cream sauce with caramelized garlic and Italian herbs — no roux needed, on the table in ~35 minutes.

                                                        Chicken

                                                        • 2 large chicken breasts (about 24 oz)
                                                        • 2 tbsp flour
                                                        • 1 tsp EACH salt, garlic powder, onion powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp EACH pepper, paprika
                                                        • 2 tbsp unsalted butter
                                                        • 2 tbsp olive oil

                                                        Creamy garlic parmesan sauce

                                                        • 10 garlic cloves, whole
                                                        • 1 shallot, chopped
                                                        • 2 garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth
                                                        • 1 tbsp cornstarch
                                                        • 1 cup heavy cream
                                                        • 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
                                                        • 1 tsp Dijon mustard
                                                        • 1 tsp chicken bouillon (granulated, crushed cube or Better Than Bouillon)
                                                        • 1 tsp EACH dried parsley, dried basil (or 1 tbsp EACH fresh)
                                                        • 1/2 tsp dried oregano
                                                        • 1/4 tsp dried thyme
                                                        • 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
                                                        • 1/3 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
                                                        • 1/2 tbsp lemon juice (optional)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Smash 5 garlic cloves and peel the rest; set aside.
                                                        2. Slice each chicken breast in half through the equator to make 4 fillets; pound to an even thickness and pat dry.
                                                        3. Whisk the flour and chicken seasonings in a shallow dish; dredge each cutlet, shaking off excess.
                                                        4. Melt the butter in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through (160°F). Transfer to a plate without wiping out the skillet.
                                                        5. Reduce heat to medium. Add the chopped shallot, smashed and whole garlic cloves to the drippings; sauté ~3 minutes, scraping up the browned bits, until the shallots soften and the garlic caramelizes. Add the minced garlic and sauté 2 more minutes.
                                                        6. Reduce heat to low and stir in the heavy cream. Mix the chicken broth with the cornstarch and add to the skillet with the Worcestershire, Dijon, bouillon and all sauce seasonings.
                                                        7. Bring to a simmer, stirring often, until the sauce thickens almost to the desired consistency; whisk in the Parmesan until melted, then the lemon juice.
                                                        8. Return the chicken to the pan, spoon sauce over, and gently simmer 1 minute. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over mashed potatoes, pasta or rice.

                                                        Chutney Mac & Cheese Bombs

                                                        https://www.theglobalvegetarian.com/recipes/chutney-mac-and-cheese-bombs

                                                        Crispy Indian-fusion appetizer — cheesy mac & cheese balls with a creamy coriander-chutney core, coated in crushed chips and deep- or air-fried.

                                                        Mac & cheese

                                                        • Elbow macaroni
                                                        • Butter
                                                        • All-purpose flour
                                                        • Milk
                                                        • Shredded cheese (Amul processed, mozzarella, pepper jack or a blend)
                                                        • Salt
                                                        • Pepper
                                                        • Chili flakes
                                                        • Nutmeg or ajwain
                                                        • Oregano

                                                        Filling

                                                        • Cream cheese
                                                        • Coriander chutney (homemade or store-bought)

                                                        Coating

                                                        • All-purpose flour
                                                        • Water
                                                        • Chips of your choice (cheddar or classic), crushed
                                                        • Oil, for frying or air-frying

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Make the cheese sauce: melt butter, add flour and cook 2-3 minutes on low-medium. Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Add salt, pepper, chili flakes, nutmeg/ajwain and oregano; stir to avoid lumps. Melt in the shredded cheese, fold in the cooked al dente macaroni and cook 2-3 minutes. Spread in a shallow dish, press cling wrap onto the surface and refrigerate 2-3 hours.
                                                        2. Mix the softened cream cheese with the coriander chutney until smooth; keep chilled.
                                                        3. Scoop ~3 tbsp of chilled mac and cheese, make a well, place ~1/2 tbsp chutney filling inside, seal and shape into round balls. Freeze the filled balls 1 hour.
                                                        4. Crush the chips. Mix flour and water into a slurry. Dip each ball in the slurry, coat with crushed chips, and repeat for a double coat (extra crunch and shape).
                                                        5. Deep fry until golden and crispy, or air fry at 400°F for 8-14 minutes, flipping gently midway.
                                                        6. Serve hot with ketchup, spicy mayo, yogurt-mint chutney or tamarind-date chutney.

                                                        Brown sugar cookies

                                                        • All-purpose flour

                                                        Sausage Dum Biryani

                                                        A party-style dum biryani made with chicken sausages instead of meat — sautéed sausages layered with spiced masala and steamed rice, sealed and slow-cooked on dum.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 4-5 chicken sausages
                                                        • 2 tbsp oil
                                                        • 1 bay leaf
                                                        • 2-3 black peppercorns
                                                        • 1 cinnamon stick
                                                        • 2-3 cloves
                                                        • 1 tsp sahi jeera (caraway seeds)

                                                        • 1 large tomato
                                                        • 1-inch piece ginger
                                                        • 1 green chilli
                                                        • 5-6 garlic cloves

                                                        • 1.5 tsp red chilli powder

                                                        • 1/2 tsp garam masala powder
                                                        • 1 tbsp butter

                                                        • Few mint leaves and 1 tsp kasuri methi
                                                        • 1/2 lemon
                                                        • 1 cup rice (2 servings)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Chop the sausages and sauté till they are slightly crispy on the outside.
                                                        2. In a pot, heat oil and add the whole spices, followed by chopped onions.
                                                        3. Simultaneously wash and soak the rice for 15 minutes. Once soaked, add it to boiling water and cook for 6 minutes on high flame. Drain and keep aside.
                                                        4. Grind the tomato, ginger, garlic and green chilli together into a paste.
                                                        5. Once the onions are 80% golden brown, add the paste followed by salt. Sauté till the colour changes to reddish brown.
                                                        6. Add the masalas and the sausages. Add some water if it is very dry and squeeze in the lemon.
                                                        7. Cover and cook for 5 minutes (sausages don't need long). Add the kasuri methi and mint leaves.
                                                        8. Add the steamed rice on top. Top with mint/coriander leaves, garam masala and butter.
                                                        9. Preheat a pan on the side. Place the pot on the pan, cover with foil paper so the flavours stay intact, and cook on low for 20-25 minutes.

                                                        • 1 tbsp soy sauce

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. For the sauce: heat the oil and fry the onion about 6 minutes, then add the garlic and ginger for 1-2 minutes. Stir in the curry powder, turmeric, chilli powder and tomato puree to coat.
                                                        2. Pour in the chicken stock and simmer about 8 minutes. Stir in the vinegar, honey and soy sauce; cook 3 more minutes until thickened, then blitz smooth with a stick blender.
                                                        3. Bash each chicken breast between parchment to about 2-3 cm thick. Whisk the egg with the soy sauce; set out the seasoned flour and panko.
                                                        4. Dip each breast in flour, then the egg mixture, then the panko, pressing to coat.
                                                        5. Fry in the hot oil 5-6 minutes until golden and cooked through; drain on kitchen paper.
                                                        6. Slice the chicken and serve over sticky rice with the curry sauce and spring onions.

                                                        Onion Tomato Thokku

                                                        https://www.tomatoblues.com/onion-tomato-thokku-recipe-video/

                                                        A tangy, no-grind onion and tomato relish — great with idli, dosa, chapati, or as a spread. Keeps a week in the fridge.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1 tbsp oil (any neutral vegetable oil)
                                                        • 1 tsp mustard seeds
                                                        • 1 tsp fennel seeds
                                                        • 1 cup finely chopped red onions
                                                        • 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
                                                        • 1 1/2 tsp salt, or to taste
                                                        • 1 tsp red chilli powder
                                                        • 1 tsp coriander powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
                                                        • 1 1/2 cups finely chopped tomatoes (about 4 medium)
                                                        • 3/4 tsp sambar powder
                                                        • 1/2-1 cup water
                                                        • 10 fresh curry leaves
                                                        • 2 tbsp finely chopped coriander leaves

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Heat the oil, add the mustard seeds and, once they pop, the fennel seeds; let them crackle.
                                                        2. Add the onions and saute lightly, then stir in the ginger-garlic paste and salt. Cook on medium flame until the onions turn pink and soft.
                                                        3. Lower the flame and add the red chilli, turmeric and coriander powders; saute about 30 seconds.
                                                        4. Add the chopped tomatoes, curry leaves and sambar powder; cook on medium flame until the tomatoes break down.
                                                        5. Cover and cook about 5 minutes on medium flame, stirring once in between.
                                                        6. Add water to adjust consistency and mash lightly with a potato masher. Simmer 2-3 minutes.
                                                        7. Garnish with coriander leaves. Serve with idli, dosa, poori or chapati.

                                                        • 1/2 cup shredded pepper jack cheese

                                                        2. Cut each tortilla from the centre straight down to the edge. Spread the chicken over one quarter, the lettuce/peppers/green onions over the next, ranch over the third, and the cheeses over the last.

                                                        Parrupu Sadam (Katti Paruppu Dal Rice)

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        A Tamil comfort classic: mashed toor dal with a shallot-garlic tempering, served over rice.

                                                        To boil

                                                        • 3/4 cup toor dal
                                                        • Water, as required (about 1 cup)
                                                        • 1/2 tsp salt
                                                        • 1/4 tsp turmeric powder

                                                        Tempering

                                                        • 2 tbsp oil
                                                        • 2 tsp mustard seeds
                                                        • 2 tsp urad dal
                                                        • 1 sprig curry leaves
                                                        • 3 dry red chillies, deseeded
                                                        • 20 shallots, sliced
                                                        • 4 garlic cloves, crushed
                                                        • Ghee, to finish

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Wash and soak the toor dal for 20 minutes, then boil until completely cooked and mash it (about 4 whistles in a pressure cooker).
                                                        2. Heat the oil in a pot and splutter the mustard seeds. Add the urad dal, dry red chillies and curry leaves and let them crackle.
                                                        3. Add the garlic and shallots and saute for a minute.
                                                        4. Stir in the boiled dal, bring to a boil, add ghee and take off the flame.
                                                        5. Serve hot with rice, potato chips and pickle.

                                                        Muringaila Parippu Curry (Dal with Moringa Leaves)

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        A comforting Kerala-style dal with moringa leaves, finished with a coconut paste and a shallot tempering.

                                                        Dal

                                                        • 1/3 cup toor dal
                                                        • 2 1/2 cups water
                                                        • Salt, to taste
                                                        • 1/4 tsp turmeric powder
                                                        • 3/4 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder
                                                        • 1 tsp oil
                                                        • 1 big onion, sliced
                                                        • 1 tomato, roughly chopped

                                                        Coconut paste

                                                        • 1/2 cup grated coconut
                                                        • 1/2 green chilli
                                                        • 1 big garlic clove
                                                        • 1/4 tsp cumin
                                                        • Water, as needed

                                                        Tempering

                                                        • 3 tbsp oil
                                                        • 1 tsp mustard seeds
                                                        • 3-4 dry chillies
                                                        • A handful of sliced shallots
                                                        • Moringa leaves, as required

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Pressure-cook the toor dal with water, salt, turmeric, Kashmiri chilli powder, oil, onion and tomato for about 15 minutes.
                                                        2. Grind the grated coconut with green chilli, garlic, cumin and a little water into a fine paste.
                                                        3. Stir the coconut paste into the cooked dal and simmer for about 5 minutes.
                                                        4. For the tempering, heat the oil and splutter the mustard seeds and dry chillies. Add the shallots and saute until cooked, then add the moringa leaves and cook until wilted.
                                                        5. Pour the tempering over the dal and serve.
