                                                        Palak Paneer Dosa with Garlic Tomato Chutney

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        A green spinach dosa topped with garlic-tomato chutney and grated paneer — a breakfast-table hit.

                                                        For the dosa

                                                        • 1 cup urad dal
                                                        • 2 cups idli rice or normal rice
                                                        • 1/2 tsp methi seeds
                                                        • 1/2 cup spinach (palak) puree
                                                        • Oil or ghee, for making the dosa
                                                        • Paneer, grated, as required
                                                        • Salt, to taste

                                                        For the garlic tomato chutney

                                                        • 1 tsp oil
                                                        • 2 pods garlic, peeled
                                                        • 6-7 dry red chillies
                                                        • 2 tomatoes
                                                        • Salt, to taste

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Wash the urad dal, rice and methi seeds 3-4 times, then soak in enough water for 6-8 hours or overnight.
                                                        2. Grind to a batter and let it ferment for 8-10 hours. Mix well, then stir in the spinach puree and salt; add water as needed to reach dosa-batter consistency.
                                                        3. For the chutney, heat the oil and cook the garlic and dry red chillies for a minute. Add the tomatoes and salt and cook until soft. Cool, then grind to a coarse chutney.
                                                        4. Heat a dosa tawa and spread the batter into a dosa. Drizzle ghee or oil around the edges. When the top is partially cooked, spread over the chutney and sprinkle with grated paneer.
                                                        5. Fold and serve hot with your favourite chutney.

                                                        French Dip Sandwich

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Slow-caramelized onions, seared chuck roast, Gruyere and garlic aioli with a dipping jus.

                                                        Sandwich

                                                        • 4 onions
                                                        • 1 stick butter
                                                        • 1/2 tsp sea salt
                                                        • 1 chuck roast
                                                        • Salt and pepper, to season
                                                        • 1 qt beef stock
                                                        • 1 tsp sea salt
                                                        • 3 cloves garlic
                                                        • 1 spring rosemary
                                                        • 1 sprig thyme
                                                        • 4 baguettes or rolls
                                                        • Garlic aioli
                                                        • 1 cup shredded Gruyere
                                                        • Minced parsley, to garnish

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Slice the onions and add to a large cast iron or stainless steel pan with the butter and sea salt. Cook on low for about 3 hours until caramelized.
                                                        2. Remove the onions, leaving the bits and butter in the pan.
                                                        3. Season the chuck roast with sea salt and pepper; increase heat to medium-high and sear each side.
                                                        4. Leave the roast in the pan; add the beef stock, rosemary, sea salt, thyme and garlic.
                                                        5. Bring to a simmer and cook about 30 minutes until the chuck roast is medium done.
                                                        6. Toast the bread in the oven while the beef cooks.
                                                        7. Remove the beef, leaving the soupy au jus; slice the meat very thinly.
                                                        8. Spread a thick layer of garlic aioli on the bread; add the caramelized onions, sliced meat, shredded Gruyere and parsley.
                                                        9. Serve with a small dipping bowl of the jus and enjoy!

                                                        Pesarattu Upma (Andhra Pradesh)

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Ep 5 of a 28-states breakfast series: pesarattu with upma and ginger chutney.

                                                        Pesarattu

                                                        • Broken moong dal (lazy version: soak in warm water a couple of hours) OR whole moong dal (elite version: soak overnight)
                                                        • Green chillies
                                                        • Ginger
                                                        • Cumin seeds
                                                        • Salt

                                                        Upma

                                                        • Oil
                                                        • Cumin seeds
                                                        • Coriander seeds
                                                        • Chana dal
                                                        • Onion, sauteed till translucent
                                                        • Salt
                                                        • Rava (roasted)
                                                        • Ghee, to finish

                                                        Allam Pachadi (Ginger Chutney)

                                                        • Heap loads of ginger
                                                        • Chana dal
                                                        • Tamarind
                                                        • Jaggery

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Pesarattu: grind the soaked moong dal into a smooth batter with green chillies, ginger, cumin seeds and salt. Spread thin on a hot griddle and cook.
                                                        2. Upma: heat oil; add cumin seeds, coriander seeds and chana dal. Saute onion till translucent with salt.
                                                        3. Add water in a 2:1 ratio with the rava; bring to a boil, add roasted rava and mix till cooked.
                                                        4. Top with ghee and fold to make it smooth.
                                                        5. Allam pachadi: saute ginger, chana dal, tamarind and jaggery; puree into a chutney.
                                                        6. Serve the pesarattu with upma and ginger chutney.

                                                        Chicken 65

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Not-too-spicy Chicken 65 with a yogurt-based sauce — perfect for desi taste buds.

                                                        Chicken Marinade

                                                        • 2 lbs chicken
                                                        • 1/2 tsp salt (or to taste)
                                                        • 3/4 tsp red chili powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp Kashmiri chili powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp black pepper powder
                                                        • 4 tbsp all purpose flour
                                                        • 4 tbsp corn starch
                                                        • 2 eggs
                                                        • 2 tbsp ginger garlic paste
                                                        • 2-3 tbsp lemon or lime juice
                                                        • 1/8 tsp red food coloring (optional)

                                                        Sauce

                                                        • 1/2 cup yogurt
                                                        • 1/2 tsp red chili (or Kashmiri chili)
                                                        • 1/2 tsp garam masala
                                                        • 1/2 tsp salt
                                                        • 2 tbsp oil
                                                        • 1 tsp cumin seeds
                                                        • 2-3 green chilies
                                                        • 1/8 tsp red food coloring

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces. Marinate with all marinade ingredients for about 30 minutes.
                                                        2. Heat oil for deep frying and fry the chicken 5-6 minutes. Don't over-fry, since it also cooks with the sauce.
                                                        3. Mix all the sauce ingredients except the cumin seeds, oil and green chilies.
                                                        4. Heat 2 tbsp oil, add cumin seeds and green chilies and let the cumin crackle.
                                                        5. Add the yogurt sauce and cook a few minutes until the oil separates. Add the fried chicken and cook only until well combined.
                                                        6. Tip: don't overcook the chicken or it will harden.

                                                        Classic Chicken Noodle Soup

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        The perfect bowl of chicken noodle soup for a freezing day.

                                                        Soup

                                                        • 1 tbsp olive oil
                                                        • 1 tbsp butter
                                                        • 1 yellow onion, diced
                                                        • 3 celery stalks, sliced
                                                        • 3 carrots, sliced
                                                        • 6 cloves garlic, minced
                                                        • 1 inch piece peeled ginger
                                                        • 10-12 cups chicken broth
                                                        • 1 sprig fresh thyme and parsley
                                                        • 2 bay leaves
                                                        • 3 small chicken breasts, shredded (seasoned with a bit of salt)
                                                        • 1.5 tsp salt (or to taste)
                                                        • 1/2 tsp freshly ground black pepper
                                                        • 275 g egg noodles

                                                        Garnish

                                                        • Chopped fresh parsley
                                                        • Fresh lemon juice

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Heat olive oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat.
                                                        2. Add the chopped onions, celery and carrots; cook 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
                                                        3. Stir in the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
                                                        4. Add the chicken broth, stirring up all the browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
                                                        5. Add the thyme, parsley, ginger chunk and bay leaves; increase heat to high and bring to a simmer.
                                                        6. Add salt and pepper; stir, then cover and simmer over medium heat 25-30 minutes, or until the veg are soft.
                                                        7. Add the shredded chicken to the mixture.
                                                        8. Cook the egg noodles in the broth or separately (separately is better if you'll have leftovers).
                                                        9. Discard the thyme, bay leaves and ginger pieces. Taste for salt and adjust.
                                                        10. Garnish with parsley and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice.

                                                        Lazy Girl Tiramisu (No-Bake)

                                                        Full recipe on creator's website (lifestyleofafoodie.com)

                                                        The no-bake dessert that gets better with time — creamy mascarpone layers with espresso-soaked ladyfingers, no raw eggs. Make 1-3 days before serving.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1-1/2 cups heavy cream
                                                        • 8 oz mascarpone cheese, at room temperature
                                                        • 1/3 cup granulated sugar
                                                        • 2 tsp vanilla extract
                                                        • 1-1/2 cups strong espresso, at room temperature
                                                        • 1 package ladyfingers
                                                        • Cocoa powder, for dusting

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Add the cream, sugar and vanilla to a mixer bowl; whip until stiff peaks form.
                                                        2. Add the room-temperature mascarpone and mix just until well incorporated — don't over-mix.
                                                        3. Pour the cooled espresso into a shallow bowl; dip the ladyfingers quickly (5-8 seconds) and line an 8x8 pan.
                                                        4. Spread half the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers; repeat with another layer of dipped ladyfingers and the remaining cream.
                                                        5. Dust generously with cocoa powder; refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight.

                                                        Cold mascarpone makes the filling lumpy — bring it to room temperature first. Keeps 3 days refrigerated.

                                                        Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato & Ricotta Stuffed Shells

                                                        Full recipe on creator's website (dishingouthealth.com)

                                                        Restaurant-worthy jumbo shells filled with a spinach-ricotta mixture, baked in a bright sun-dried tomato cream sauce with melty mozzarella. Make-ahead and freezer-friendly.

                                                        Shells & Sauce

                                                        • 23-26 jumbo pasta shells
                                                        • 2 tbsp oil from the sun-dried tomato jar
                                                        • 1/2 cup finely chopped shallots
                                                        • 4 garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 1 cup chicken or vegetable broth
                                                        • 1-1/2 cups half-and-half or heavy cream
                                                        • 1/2 cup grated parmesan, divided
                                                        • 3/4 cup slivered oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes
                                                        • 1 tsp Italian seasoning
                                                        • 3/4 tsp kosher salt, divided
                                                        • 3/4 tsp cracked black pepper, divided

                                                        Filling

                                                        • 1 (16-oz) bag frozen spinach, thawed
                                                        • 2 cups (16-oz) whole-milk ricotta
                                                        • 1 tsp lemon zest
                                                        • 3/4 cup shredded mozzarella

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the shells in salted boiling water until just shy of al dente, about 10 minutes; drain and drizzle with a little olive oil so they don't stick.
                                                        2. Heat the tomato-jar oil in a large skillet over medium; add the shallots and garlic; cook 3-5 minutes until soft.
                                                        3. Stir in the broth, half-and-half, 1/4 cup parmesan, Italian seasoning, sun-dried tomatoes, 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp pepper; simmer 7-10 minutes until slightly thickened.
                                                        4. Squeeze the thawed spinach dry in a clean kitchen towel; mix with the ricotta, remaining 1/4 cup parmesan, lemon zest, and 1/4 tsp each salt and pepper.
                                                        5. Fill each shell with the ricotta mixture. Pour half the sauce into a 9x13 baking dish; arrange the shells over it; spoon the remaining sauce on top; scatter with mozzarella.
                                                        6. Cover tightly with foil and bake 15 minutes; uncover and bake about 15 minutes more, until the cheese is melted and the sauce is bubbling. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

                                                        Can be assembled 1 day ahead and refrigerated; freezer-friendly up to 3 months.

                                                        Lightened Scalloped Potatoes

                                                        Full recipe on creator's website (alliecarte.com)

                                                        A lighter take on cheesy scalloped potatoes — creamy and cheesy at just 179 calories a serving. Makes 9 servings.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 3 lbs yukon gold potatoes
                                                        • 1 tbsp light margarine
                                                        • 1/8 cup diced white onion
                                                        • 4 cloves garlic, minced
                                                        • 1 tbsp thyme
                                                        • 1/2 tbsp basil
                                                        • 1 tsp salt
                                                        • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp onion powder
                                                        • 1/4 tsp black pepper
                                                        • Pinch of nutmeg
                                                        • Pinch of paprika
                                                        • 1 cup plain, unsweetened almond milk
                                                        • 1 tbsp arrowroot powder (or 1-1/2 tsp cornstarch)
                                                        • 1 cup shredded mozzarella, fat-free
                                                        • 1/4 cup shredded cheddar, fat-free

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Preheat the oven to 400°F; spray a 9x9 casserole dish with cooking spray.
                                                        2. Slice the potatoes into 1/8-inch slices; layer half in the dish in overlapping layers.
                                                        3. Heat a medium saucepan over medium-high; melt the margarine, add the onion and garlic, and cook 3-5 minutes until softened; stir in the seasonings.
                                                        4. Reduce heat to medium-low; stir in the arrowroot powder, then whisk in the milk a little at a time until smooth.
                                                        5. Bring to a slight simmer; add 3/4 cup of the mozzarella and the cheddar; stir until melted.
                                                        6. Pour half the cheese sauce over the potatoes; arrange the remaining potatoes on top; cover with the remaining sauce; sprinkle the reserved mozzarella over.
                                                        7. Bake 60 minutes, until the potatoes are softened to your liking; cut into 9 squares and serve.

                                                        Dal Tadka

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 200g toor dal
                                                        • 1 tsp turmeric
                                                        • 850ml water
                                                        • 4 cloves garlic, crushed
                                                        • 1 thumb size piece of ginger, crushed
                                                        • 1 long green chilli, crushed
                                                        • 4 tbsp ghee
                                                        • 1 tsp cumin seeds
                                                        • 1 tbsp coriander seeds
                                                        • 2 cloves
                                                        • 1 red onion, diced
                                                        • 4 tomatoes, diced
                                                        • 0.5 tsp coriander powder
                                                        • 0.25 tsp garam masala
                                                        • 0.5 teaspoon Kashmiri chilli powder
                                                        • 1 bunch coriander, finely cut
                                                        • 1 tbsp kasoori methi
                                                        • Salt to taste

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Start by cooking the toor dal with the turmeric and 700ml water in a pressure cooker on high for 8 minutes.
                                                        2. In a heavy base pot or dutch oven, add 1/2 the ghee and place on medium heat. Add the cumin seeds, coriander seeds and cloves. Saute for 30 seconds.
                                                        3. Add the garlic, ginger and green chilli and cook for 2 minutes.
                                                        4. Next, add the onions and cook for 4 minutes or until they are soft.
                                                        5. Add the tomatoes and season with salt. Cook this with the lid on until the tomatoes are soft, roughly 10 minutes.
                                                        6. Now add the cooked dal.
                                                        7. Add the rest of the dry spices and stir well.
                                                        8. Heat a charcoal over a flame and place it into a metal bowl, add the bowl to the centre of the dal pot and pour in 2 tbsp of melted ghee, put the lid on and leave on the heat for 5 minutes.
                                                        9. Remove the bowl with the coal and stir through the last of the coriander.
                                                        10. In a separate pan, heat 2 tbsp of ghee and once hot add 1 crushed garlic clove, and 2 dried chillies and cook for 1 minute before adding 1 tsp of Kashmiri chilli powder.
                                                        11. Pour this over the dal and stir through.
                                                        12. Serve with rice and naan or roti. Enjoy!

                                                        Baked Rosemary Chicken Meatballs with Creamy Tomato Orzo

                                                        Transcribed from source website

                                                        Baked Rosemary Chicken Meatballs

                                                        • 2 oz fresh italian bread, diced
                                                        • 1/2 cup warm water
                                                        • 2 tbsp butter
                                                        • 1 shallot, minced
                                                        • 4 garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 1 tsp granulated garlic
                                                        • 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
                                                        • 1 1/2 lbs ground chicken thigh
                                                        • 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese
                                                        • 1/2 cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes (in olive oil)
                                                        • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
                                                        • 2 tsp chopped fresh rosemary
                                                        • 1/4 tsp kosher salt

                                                        Tomato Orzo

                                                        • 1 tbsp butter
                                                        • 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato olive oil (from the jar)
                                                        • 1 sprig rosemary
                                                        • 1 shallot, minced
                                                        • 4 garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 1/4 cup tomato paste
                                                        • 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
                                                        • 1/4 cup dry white wine
                                                        • 1 cup orzo
                                                        • 2 1/4 cups chicken stock
                                                        • 1/4 cup heavy cream
                                                        • 2 oz fresh spinach (approximately 2 cups)
                                                        • 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese, plus more for serving

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. For the meatballs, preheat the oven to 450F. Prepare a sheet pan with a piece of parchment paper. Place the diced bread in a large mixing bowl and pour the warm water over top. Let soak, submerged, for at least 5 minutes.
                                                        2. Heat a 12" stainless steel skillet over medium heat. Add the butter. Once melted, add the minced shallot and garlic. Cook for a minute or so until softened. Stir in the granulated garlic and red pepper flakes. Turn off the heat.
                                                        3. Add the ground chicken, parmesan, sun-dried tomatoes, rosemary, parsley, salt, and shallot mixture to the bowl of bread. Mix until incorporated. Form the mixture into approximately 16 (2 oz) meatballs, packing them tightly. Place them onto the prepared sheet pan. Drizzle with olive oil and bake on the top rack of the oven for 25-30 minutes, or until golden and cooked through.
                                                        4. For the orzo, wipe out the skillet and place it back over medium heat. Add the butter and sun-dried tomato oil. Add the rosemary sprig. Let it crisp on both sides as the butter begins to brown. Transfer the rosemary to a paper towel.
                                                        5. Add the shallots and garlic to the butter and season with a pinch of salt. Cook for about 2 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and red pepper flakes until the paste is incorporated. Stir in the white wine and then add the orzo. Bring the wine to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, stirring often. Add the chicken stock. Bring to a simmer again, reduce the heat to medium-low, and cook for about 8 more minutes, stirring often.
                                                        6. Add the heavy cream, spinach, and parmesan. Let the cream simmer while the spinach wilts and parmesan melts, stirring continuously. Season with salt if needed.
                                                        7. Serve the chicken meatballs over the orzo. Garnish with the crispy rosemary leaves, more parmesan, and any extra chopped parsley.

                                                        Transcribed from the creator's own recipe page (The Original Dish): https://www.theoriginaldish.com/2022/12/14/baked-rosemary-chicken-meatballs-with-tomato-orzo/ — serves 4. Note the page titles it 'Baked Rosemary Chicken Meatballs with Tomato Orzo'.

                                                        Cheesy Gruyere Potato Gratin

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 5 tablespoons butter
                                                        • 2 sprigs rosemary, finely chopped
                                                        • 4 garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 1 teaspoon black peppercorns, coarsely ground
                                                        • 1 shallot, finely chopped
                                                        • 1 cup heavy cream
                                                        • 2 lbs (1 kg) Russet potatoes, about 6 medium ones, peeled and washed
                                                        • 125 g (about 1 1/4 cups) Le Gruyère AOP, shredded
                                                        • Kosher salt

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Heat the oven to 400F. Grease a 10-inch cast iron skillet with 2 tbs of butter.
                                                        2. Thinly slice the potatoes using a mandolin, into 3 to 5 mm slices. Add the potatoes to a large bowl with cold water. Set aside.
                                                        3. Add the remaining butter, rosemary, garlic, pepper, and shallot to a small saucepan over medium low heat, and sizzle for a few minutes, until softened. Add the cream, bring to a boil, lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Set aside.
                                                        4. Drain the potatoes and place them back in the large bowl. Pour the cream mixture over the potatoes.
                                                        5. Sprinkle 75 g or 3/4 cup of cheese all over the potatoes. Toss to coat the potatoes in cream and cheese. Season the potatoes with a big pinch of salt.
                                                        6. Arrange the potatoes in a circular motion throughout the skillet. Pour over the remaining infused cream. Cover the skillet with aluminum foil. Place on the middle rack and bake for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes, covered.
                                                        7. Remove from the oven, remove the foil off the skillet and sprinkle the remaining 50 g or 1/2 cup of cheese all over the gratin. Place back in the oven and bake for 15 to 18 minutes, or until the cheese on top is golden brown and melty.

                                                        Miso + Sansho Peppercorn Steak Sauce

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Steak

                                                        • Steak
                                                        • Salt
                                                        • Pepper
                                                        • Neutral oil

                                                        Sauce

                                                        • Garlic
                                                        • Shallot
                                                        • Ground pepper
                                                        • Sake
                                                        • Beef broth
                                                        • Red miso
                                                        • Sansho pepper
                                                        • Heavy cream
                                                        • Parsley, finely chopped
                                                        • Butter

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Season the steak with salt and pepper. Sear it in neutral oil in a skillet over high heat until it reaches your preferred doneness, then set aside.
                                                        2. Turn the heat down to medium and, in the same oil, add the garlic, shallot, and ground pepper. Cook until the shallots are translucent.
                                                        3. Turn the heat up slightly and pour in the sake to deglaze the pan. Scrape up any browned bits with a wooden spoon, then reduce the sake by half.
                                                        4. Turn the heat back down to medium and pour in the beef broth. Bring to a low boil, then add the red miso and sansho pepper, stirring to combine.
                                                        5. Reduce the heat to low, then pour in the heavy cream. Stir and let the sauce thicken to a gravy-like consistency, adjusting with salt to taste.
                                                        6. Finish the sauce by stirring in finely chopped parsley, then toss in the butter and swirl the pan to combine. Cut the heat.
                                                        7. To plate, spoon a generous amount of the sauce onto the plate, slice the steak and place it on top of the bed of sauce, then spoon more sauce over to finish.

                                                        • 1 star anise

                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon cumin seeds
                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon fennel seeds
                                                        • 1/4 teaspoon fenugreek seeds
                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon kesoori methi (fenugreek leaves)
                                                        • 1 teaspoon roasted cumin powder
                                                        • 3 tablespoons oil
                                                        • 3 tablespoons ghee
                                                        • 1 onion, sliced
                                                        • 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger + garlic paste
                                                        • 1 lb chicken
                                                        • Salt to taste

                                                        Rice

                                                        • 2 bay leaves
                                                        • 4 black peppercorns
                                                        • 2 cinnamon sticks
                                                        • 3 cloves
                                                        • 1 star anise
                                                        • 1/2 (teaspoon) cumin seeds
                                                        • 1/2 onion, chopped
                                                        • 1 tablespoon ginger + garlic paste
                                                        • 4 cups basmati rice
                                                        • 5 cups boiling water
                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon kewra water
                                                        • 1/2 teaspoon rose water

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Wash your rice, soak it for 30 minutes, and then dry for 30 minutes.
                                                        2. In the meantime, in a pot, dry roast the spices for the chicken curry and then blend.
                                                        3. Add the oil and ghee along with the onions, ginger, and garlic paste.
                                                        4. Add the chicken, chilis, yogurt, salt, nutmeg, cumin, and fenugreek leaves.
                                                        5. Let the chicken cook down till its natural juices get thick as a gravy with the lid on.
                                                        6. Stir every 20 minutes, so the chicken doesn't stick to the pan.
                                                        7. After an hour the chicken should be tender and brown.
                                                        8. Transfer the chicken into a separate bowl.
                                                        9. In the same pot, add the ghee and dry spices till fragrant.
                                                        10. Add in the onions, ginger and garlic paste till it's soft and translucent.
                                                        11. Add your dry rice along with the chilis.
                                                        12. Pour in the boiling hot water and let the rice come to a slight simmer.
                                                        13. Drizzle the kewra and rose water and set the pan low.
                                                        14. Cook the rice on low flame for 30 minutes.
                                                        15. Fluff it up and serve with curry!

                                                        Caption's ingredient list does not give quantities for chilis or yogurt, though the instructions mention them; quantities for the curry spices '1/2 Cumin Seeds' and '1/2 Onion' in the rice are as written in the caption (unit not specified).

                                                        Cinnamon Oatmeal Cookies with Toffee, White Chocolate, and Graham Crackers

                                                        Transcribed from source website

                                                        Cookies

                                                        • 1 cup butter
                                                        • 1 cup sugar
                                                        • 1/2 cup brown sugar
                                                        • 2 eggs
                                                        • 1 tsp vanilla
                                                        • 2 cups flour
                                                        • 1 tbsp cornstarch
                                                        • 1 tbsp cinnamon
                                                        • 1/2 tsp baking soda
                                                        • 1/2 tsp baking powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp salt
                                                        • 1 1/2 cups rolled oats
                                                        • 1/2 cup toffee bits
                                                        • 1/2 cup white chocolate chips
                                                        • 1/2 cup graham cracker chunks

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Add butter, sugar and brown sugar to a bowl; beat with a stand or hand mixer for 4-5 minutes until lighter and fluffy. Add eggs and vanilla and mix again.
                                                        2. Add flour, cornstarch, cinnamon, baking soda, baking powder and salt; mix until just barely combined. Fold in the oats, toffee, white chocolate and graham crackers until evenly distributed.
                                                        3. Small cookies: scoop with a 1 tbsp cookie scoop onto a lined baking sheet. Preheat oven to 350F; chill the dough balls in the fridge while it preheats. Bake 8-11 minutes, until cookies are just starting to brown.
                                                        4. Large cookies: measure 1/2 cup of dough per cookie. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze 2 hours or refrigerate overnight. Once chilled, bake on a lined baking sheet at 350F for 12-14 minutes, until edges are just starting to brown. Let cool completely.

                                                        From Mallory Oniki (The Palatable Life), thepalatablelife.com/cinnamon-oatmeal-cookies — direct page fetch timed out; transcription verified from the site's indexed recipe card. 12 servings. Her homemade toffee sidebar: 1/2 cup (100g) granulated sugar, 2 tablespoons water, 2 tablespoons unsalted butter.

                                                        Easy Air Fryer Chicken Shawarma

                                                        Transcribed from reel

                                                        Marinade

                                                        • 1kg skinned, boneless chicken thigh
                                                        • 1 tsp Aleppo pepper (Turkish chilli flakes)
                                                        • 1 tsp Vegeta (or all purpose seasoning)
                                                        • 1 tsp baharat spice
                                                        • 1 tsp paprika
                                                        • 1 tsp ground cumin powder
                                                        • 2 tbsp oil
                                                        • 1 tsp garlic ginger paste
                                                        • 1 tsp salt
                                                        • Juice of half a lemon

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Marinate the chicken in the spices, oil, garlic ginger paste, salt, and lemon juice overnight or for a minimum of around 2 hours.
                                                        2. Pre-soak wooden skewers in water to prevent them from burning in the air fryer.
                                                        3. Skewer the chicken and cook for 35 mins in the air fryer at 180C, turning regularly to get a good colour and taste around all the edges.
                                                        4. Serve with yoghurt garlic mint sauce, tahini dressing, pickles, chilli and salads.

                                                        Creator notes you can cook in a conventional oven at 180C for a slightly longer period, rotating the meat during cooking for even colour and flavour.

                                                        Coconut Chickpea Curry

                                                        Transcribed from source website

                                                        Curry

                                                        • 2 tablespoons coconut oil
                                                        • 1 medium red onion or yellow onion, diced
                                                        • 14 ounces fresh or canned tomatoes, diced (400g)
                                                        • Sea salt & ground black pepper, to taste
                                                        • 16 ounces canned chickpeas, drained & rinsed (454g)
                                                        • 3 garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 1 1/2 tablespoons garam masala
                                                        • 1 teaspoon curry powder
                                                        • 1/4 teaspoon cumin
                                                        • 13.5 ounces canned coconut milk (383g)
                                                        • 2 teaspoons coconut flour, OPTIONAL
                                                        • 1 small lime, juice of

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Heat the coconut oil in a deep pot over medium-high heat.
                                                        2. Add the onions and tomatoes; grind sea salt and black pepper over the mixture and stir. Lower heat to medium and cook down until the tomatoes release their juices and the onions are soft, about 10 minutes.
                                                        3. Stir in the chickpeas, garlic, garam masala, curry powder and cumin until combined.
                                                        4. Add the coconut milk and stir again; add the coconut flour (optional) to slightly thicken the curry. Bring to a boil, then reduce to medium-low and simmer 10 to 12 more minutes.
                                                        5. Taste and season with salt and pepper as desired. Remove from heat, squeeze lime over the top and stir to combine (do not skip this step). Let cool slightly and serve. Enjoy!

                                                        Transcribed from Jessica Hylton's recipe card at jessicainthekitchen.com/coconut-chickpea-curry-recipe (Creamy Vegan Coconut Chickpea Curry). Serves 4. Vegan and gluten-free; full-fat canned coconut milk recommended.

                                                        6-Ingredient Chicken Curry (20 Minutes)

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A fast, flavourful midweek chicken curry built on just 6 ingredients — on the table in 20 minutes.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 2 spring onions, finely chopped
                                                        • 2 heaped tbsp garlic-ginger paste
                                                        • 500g chicken breast, cut into 3cm chunks
                                                        • 2 heaped tbsp curry powder, mixed with 100ml water
                                                        • 3 tbsp good-quality tomato paste
                                                        • 1 x 400ml tin coconut milk
                                                        • Salt, to taste

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Brown the chicken first — don't skip this step.
                                                        2. Add the tomato paste and cook until it changes colour and the oil splits to the surface, turning almost bright coral.
                                                        3. Add the curry powder slurry and roast it off until the pan goes dry.
                                                        4. Add the coconut milk and simmer so the flavours meld.
                                                        5. Season with salt to taste and serve.

                                                        Restaurant-style toum in 5 minutes with an immersion blender — 4 ingredients, perfect with chicken shawarma or any grilled chicken.

                                                        • 1 cup peeled garlic cloves (155g)
                                                        • 1/2 cup lemon juice
                                                        • 2 tsp salt
                                                        • 2 cups neutral oil (avocado, grapeseed, canola or sunflower)

                                                        Steps

                                                        Khoya White Chane

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Creamy white chickpeas with khoya-style richness; crushed black pepper and brown-onion oil are the taste-changers.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 400g white chickpeas, soaked 1/2 hour
                                                        • 1/3 cup red lentils
                                                        • 1/2 tsp baking soda
                                                        • 2-1/2 glasses water
                                                        • 1/3 cup oil
                                                        • 1 tbsp clarified butter (ghee)
                                                        • 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
                                                        • 1 tsp cumin powder
                                                        • 1 tsp all-spice powder / garam masala
                                                        • 1 tsp black pepper powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
                                                        • 2-1/2 tbsp crushed green chillies
                                                        • 1/2 cup milk
                                                        • 1 chicken cube
                                                        • Boiled chickpeas with their water
                                                        • 1-1/2 tsp salt
                                                        • 1/3 to 1/2 cup cream
                                                        • Green chillies and crushed black pepper
                                                        • 1/4 cup oil
                                                        • 1 small onion, sliced

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Cook the soaked white chickpeas with the red lentils, baking soda and water on low flame for 40 minutes (skim the whitish foam while boiling). Cook in a wok on low flame — a pressure cooker lid can get blocked by red lentils.
                                                        2. In another wok, heat the oil and ghee; add the ginger-garlic paste, cumin, all-spice, black pepper, turmeric, crushed green chillies, milk and chicken cube; cook until the oil separates.
                                                        3. Add the boiled chickpeas with their water, salt and cream.
                                                        4. Separately, brown the sliced onion in 1/4 cup oil until dark brown; add only the onion oil to the chickpeas at the end.
                                                        5. Finish with green chillies and crushed black pepper; serve.

                                                        Rajasthani Mogar ki Sabzi

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Dry Rajasthani-style split moong dal sabzi with a ginger-chilli ghee tadka. Serves 3.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1 cup mogar / split moong dal, soaked 30 minutes
                                                        • 1 tsp ghee
                                                        • 1/2 tsp cumin seeds
                                                        • Pinch of hing (asafoetida)
                                                        • 1 inch ginger, julienned
                                                        • 1/2 tsp garlic, minced
                                                        • 2 green chillies, split
                                                        • 1-2 dry red chillies, broken
                                                        • 1 big onion, chopped
                                                        • 1/2 cup tomato puree
                                                        • 1 tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp red chilli powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
                                                        • 1 tsp coriander powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp garam masala powder
                                                        • 1 tsp kasuri methi
                                                        • Salt, to taste
                                                        • Water, as required
                                                        • Lemon juice from 1 lemon
                                                        • 1/4 cup coriander leaves, finely chopped

                                                        For the Tadka

                                                        • 1 tsp ghee
                                                        • 5-6 ginger juliennes
                                                        • 1/4 tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Heat the ghee in a tadka pan; splutter the cumin seeds and hing.
                                                        2. Add the ginger juliennes and garlic; cook a few seconds.
                                                        3. Add the green chillies, dry red chillies and onion; cook until slightly browned.
                                                        4. Add the tomato puree, spice powders and salt; cook until the ghee leaves the sides.
                                                        5. Add the mogar and water; cook until the dal softens and the water is gone (do not overcook — the dal should have a bite).
                                                        6. Mix in the kasuri methi, coriander leaves and lemon juice.
                                                        7. Finish with the ginger chilli powder tadka; serve hot.

                                                        Aloo Dum Biryani

                                                        Flavourful layered dum biryani with spiced baby potatoes and saffron milk.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 2 cups basmati rice, soaked 1/2 hour
                                                        • Whole spices for rice water: 2 cardamom, 2 cloves, 1 cinnamon stick, 1/2 tsp jeera, 1/2 tsp peppercorns, 1/2 tsp ghee, 1/2 tsp salt, coriander and mint leaves
                                                        • 1/2 cup ghee or oil
                                                        • Whole spices for masala: 3 cardamoms, 3 cloves, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 bay leaves, 1 mace, 1 kapok seed, 1/2 tsp jeera, fennel and peppercorns
                                                        • 1 large onion, sliced
                                                        • 2 green chillies
                                                        • 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
                                                        • Mint and coriander leaves
                                                        • 1 large tomato
                                                        • 1 tsp biryani masala
                                                        • 1 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp turmeric
                                                        • 1 tsp salt
                                                        • 1 tbsp thick curd
                                                        • 1/4 cup water
                                                        • Baby potatoes, fried with 1/2 tsp turmeric, chilli powder, biryani masala and salt
                                                        • Juice of 1 lemon
                                                        • 1/4 cup saffron milk (1/4 tsp saffron soaked in warm milk 1/2 hr)
                                                        • 1 medium onion, fried
                                                        • 1 tbsp ghee

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Boil water with the rice-water spices; add the soaked rice and cook to 70%; drain and spread on a plate to cool to room temperature.

                                                        8. Layer the cooked rice over the masala; top with biryani masala, mint leaves, saffron milk, fried onions and ghee.

                                                        Adana Kebab (No Tools Required)

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Adana-style chicken kebabs shaped by hand and cooked on a griddle pan with just a drizzle of olive oil.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1 kg minced chicken thigh
                                                        • 1 onion
                                                        • 7 garlic cloves
                                                        • 2 tomatoes
                                                        • 1 red pepper
                                                        • 2 large red chillies

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. In a food processor, blend the onion, garlic, tomatoes, red pepper, chillies and parsley.
                                                        2. Strain the liquid from the blend and set the pulp aside; discard the liquid.
                                                        3. Mix the minced chicken with all the spices, egg, pulp and cornflour; mix very well and rest 30 minutes.
                                                        4. Heat a cast iron griddle pan with a drizzle of olive oil on low heat.
                                                        5. With damp hands, roll the mince into balls, elongate with your fingers, press flat.
                                                        6. Cook on the griddle, turning every 3-4 minutes, until golden on both sides.

                                                        No Bake Peppermint Bark Cheesecake

                                                        Full recipe on creator's website (thereciperebel.com)

                                                        Rich, creamy no-bake cheesecake loaded with white chocolate and peppermint bark, topped with whipped cream and crushed candy canes. 20 minutes to prep, 8 hours to chill.

                                                        Crust

                                                        • 1/2 cup melted butter
                                                        • 300g chocolate sandwich cookies (about 25)

                                                        Cheesecake Filling

                                                        • 1 cup white chocolate chips (170g)
                                                        • 1 cup + 2 tbsp heavy whipping cream, divided
                                                        • 24 oz full-fat cream cheese, room temperature
                                                        • 1 to 1-1/4 cups powdered sugar
                                                        • 1 tsp vanilla
                                                        • 1 tsp mint extract
                                                        • 1/2 recipe peppermint bark (about 300g / 1-1/4 cups chopped)
                                                        • 2 peppermint candy canes, optional

                                                        Garnish

                                                        • 1-1/2 cups heavy whipping cream
                                                        • 3 tbsp powdered sugar
                                                        • Crushed candy canes

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Make the crust: process the cookies with the melted butter and press into a 9-inch springform pan.
                                                        2. Melt the white chocolate with 2 tbsp of the cream and cool to room temperature.
                                                        3. Beat the cream cheese until smooth; add 1 cup sugar, vanilla and mint extract and beat until light and fluffy.
                                                        4. Beat in the cooled melted white chocolate.
                                                        5. Whip 1 cup of the cream to stiff peaks and fold into the mixture; stir in the chopped peppermint bark.
                                                        6. Spread the filling into the crust and refrigerate at least 8 hours until firm.
                                                        7. Whip the garnish cream with the powdered sugar, swirl around the edge, and top with remaining bark and crushed candy canes.

                                                        Breakfast Potatoes

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Crispy fried breakfast potatoes with bacon, onion and garlic — parboiled in chicken stock first for extra flavour. Serves 4.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1.6 lb / 750g Maris Piper or Russet potatoes, peeled and diced small
                                                        • 4 cups / 1 litre chicken stock
                                                        • 1/2 cup / 120ml vegetable oil
                                                        • 4-5 strips bacon, finely diced
                                                        • 1 small onion, finely diced
                                                        • 1 clove garlic, finely diced
                                                        • 1 tsp salt, plus more to taste
                                                        • Black pepper, to taste

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Cover the potatoes with chicken stock, add 1 tsp salt, and boil until just knife-tender. Drain (don't rinse), steam-dry in the colander at least 5 minutes, and shake to rough up the edges.
                                                        2. Fry the bacon in a large pan until starting to crisp; add the onion until softened and lightly browned, then the garlic for 1-2 minutes. Remove from the pan.
                                                        3. Heat the oil until very hot and fry the potatoes, tossing often, until deep golden and crispy (15+ minutes).
                                                        4. Drain off excess oil, stir the bacon mixture back through, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

                                                        Crunchy coated cauliflower florets with three cooking options: air fryer, oven-baked, or deep-fried.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1 medium cauliflower, cut into florets

                                                        Rudolph Chocolate Cupcakes

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        Festive gluten-free chocolate cupcakes decorated as Rudolph — with raspberries for noses, candy eyes, and piped chocolate antlers.

                                                        Cupcakes (makes 6)

                                                        • 2.5 tbsp full-fat coconut milk
                                                        • 1/3 cup melted coconut oil
                                                        • 3 eggs
                                                        • 1/3 cup maple syrup
                                                        • 1/2 tsp Pure Madagascar Vanilla Extract
                                                        • 1/2 tsp apple cider vinegar
                                                        • 1/4 cup Luker Natural Cocoa Powder
                                                        • 1 tsp baking powder
                                                        • 1/3 cup coconut flour

                                                        Frosting

                                                        • 1/4 cup coconut cream
                                                        • 6 tbsp Oat M!lk Chocolate, melted

                                                        Decorating

                                                        • 12 candy eyes
                                                        • 6 raspberries (if they're very tall, slice some of the bottom off) or red candies
                                                        • 2 tbsp Peru Dark Chocolate, melted (for antlers)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a muffin tin with 6 cupcake liners.
                                                        2. Blend together the coconut milk, coconut oil, eggs, maple syrup, vanilla, and apple cider vinegar until smooth. Blend in the cacao powder, baking powder, and coconut flour.
                                                        3. Distribute evenly between the 6 cupcake liners. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean.

                                                        Flan

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A rich, creamy caramel flan made with sweetened condensed milk, heavy cream, and whole milk, baked low and slow in a water bath and chilled overnight.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 3/4 cup granulated sugar
                                                        • 6 egg yolks
                                                        • 3 whole eggs
                                                        • 1 (14 ounce) can sweetened condensed milk
                                                        • 2 cups heavy cream
                                                        • 2 cups whole milk
                                                        • 1 tablespoon of vanilla
                                                        • A generous splash of Amaretto (optional)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Preheat the oven to 275°F.
                                                        2. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add sugar and cook undisturbed until the sugar begins to caramelize around the edges. Using a wooden spoon or rubber spatula, stir the sugar until it is amber in color, translucent, and there are no lumps, about 4-5 minutes. Use the back of the spoon to break up any lumps if necessary.
                                                        3. Pour the caramel into a 9 inch cake pan and rotate the pan to coat the interior; set aside. (Use oven mitts — sugar burns are the worst!)
                                                        4. In a large bowl, whisk together yolks, whole eggs, and sweetened condensed milk until smooth.
                                                        5. Add heavy cream, whole milk, vanilla, and amaretto. Whisk to combine.
                                                        6. Strain the custard base into the prepared cake pan and transfer to a roasting rack. Pour in enough water to reach about 3/4 up the sides of the cake pan.
                                                        7. Bake at 275°F for 3 hours or until set. It should have a little bit of bounce but it shouldn't ripple when you poke it.
                                                        8. Remove from the oven and chill overnight (do not try to flip it warm).
                                                        9. Remove the flan from the fridge 30 minutes before serving. If necessary, run a knife around the edges of the cake pan. It should move freely within the pan when you try to twist it.
                                                        10. Flip, slice, and serve.

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A weeknight take on dan dan noodles with a savory pork mince topping, a punchy sesame-chili sauce, noodles, and Asian greens — the creator notes adding pickled mustard greens gets it closer to the real thing.

                                                        Mince topping

                                                        • 250g mince of choice
                                                        • 1 tbsp shaoxing wine
                                                        • 1 tbsp soy sauce
                                                        • 1/2 tsp white pepper
                                                        • 1/4 tsp salt (caption says '1/4 salt')

                                                        • 2 cloves garlic, chopped
                                                        • 2 tbsp ginger, chopped
                                                        • 2 tsp dark soy

                                                        Sauce

                                                        • 1 tbsp sesame paste
                                                        • 1 tbsp black vinegar
                                                        • 1 tbsp soy
                                                        • 1 tbsp chilli oil
                                                        • 1 tsp sugar
                                                        • 1/2 tsp sesame oil
                                                        • 1/4 tsp ground sichuan peppers
                                                        • 1 garlic clove, minced
                                                        • 1 cup stock (or water + bouillon)

                                                        The rest

                                                        • 200g noodles of choice
                                                        • 1 bunch Asian greens of choice
                                                        • Sesame seeds
                                                        • Green onions, to garnish

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Combine well: mince, shaoxing, soy, salt, and white pepper in a bowl and let it marinate while you prep everything else.

Once it starts to smoke, spread out the pork on the pan and let it catch some colour before breaking it up (3-5 min). Add the ginger and garlic and stir fry for another 3-5 min. Add dark soy, combine well, and set aside.

                                                        5. Assemble: 2 tbsp of sauce and 1/4 cup of stock per bowl (add more stock if you like it more runny). Layer in noodles, greens, pork topping, sesame seeds, and green onions.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 6 Granny Smith apples or any apples of your choice
                                                        • 1/2 cup of granulated sugar
                                                        • 2 tsp. of cinnamon

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Peel the apples, cut in half and remove the core and stem.
                                                        2. Thaw the puff pastry sheet (for best results, overnight in the fridge). Using a rolling pin, roll it out slightly to thin the dough just right.
                                                        3. Cut the dough into 12 equal squares — 2 cuts down vertically and 3 cuts down horizontally.
                                                        4. Combine the cinnamon and sugar in a bowl.
                                                        5. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and generously sprinkle the cinnamon-sugar mixture in sections.
                                                        6. Place the apple halves face down directly on top of the cinnamon sugar.
                                                        7. Grab a square of dough, stretch it out slightly, place it directly on top of an apple and adhere the edges to the apple.
                                                        8. Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 30 minutes or until the dough is golden brown.
                                                        9. Allow to cool slightly for 5 minutes so the sugar hardens a bit, then remove from the sheet and flip over onto a plate.
                                                        10. Serve warm with any ice cream and toppings of your choice.
