                                                        Aloo Paratha

                                                        https://www.sanjanafeasts.co.uk/2020/01/aloo-paratha-potato-stuffed-flatbread/

                                                        A classic potato-stuffed flatbread popular across the Indian subcontinent and its diaspora — the trick to getting it to puff is a well-sealed paratha with the right consistency of filling and dough.

                                                        For the filling

                                                        • 5 medium potatoes (800 g), steamed, microwaved or baked in their skins until tender, then cooled
                                                        • 3 cm piece ginger, peeled and grated
                                                        • 2-3 green chillies, finely chopped
                                                        • 1 tsp garam masala
                                                        • 1 tsp ground cumin
                                                        • 1/2 tsp red chilli powder
                                                        • 1/4 tsp ajwain (carom seeds)
                                                        • 1/2 tsp amchur (dried mango powder)
                                                        • 3/4 tsp salt
                                                        • 2 tbsp finely chopped coriander leaves

                                                        For the dough

                                                        • 350 g wholewheat chapati atta, plus 4 tbsp extra for rolling
                                                        • 2 tbsp chickpea flour (besan)
                                                        • 1/2 tsp salt
                                                        • 260 ml warm water
                                                        • 1 tbsp oil
                                                        • 3 tbsp ghee or oil, for cooking

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Mix the atta, chickpea flour and salt in a large bowl. Make a well, gradually add the warm water and bring together with your hands. Knead 1-2 minutes, add the oil and knead 2 minutes more until smooth and soft. Cover with a damp tea towel and rest 15 minutes.
                                                        2. Peel the cooked, cooled potatoes and grate into a bowl. Add all the remaining filling ingredients and mash together with clean hands; it should hold its shape when rolled into a ball. Divide into 10 balls.
                                                        3. Divide the dough into 10 balls, about the same size as the filling. Cover again.
                                                        4. Pre-heat a tawa or frying pan.
                                                        5. Roll or pat a dough ball to about 8 cm. Place a portion of filling on top and pinch the dough closed around it fully, with no gaps.
                                                        6. On a bed of extra atta, pat the ball into a thick round disc with your middle three fingers, working from the centre outwards to distribute the filling evenly.
                                                        7. Roll gently with a rolling pin in a circular motion between centre and edges (not straight over the middle), turning as you go, until the desired size.
                                                        8. Cook on the preheated tawa over medium heat 30-40 seconds; flip, brush oil over the surface and cook a minute; flip again and oil the second side. It should puff slightly and turn golden all over. Keep warm under a kitchen towel and repeat.
                                                        9. Serve hot with pickle, plain yoghurt and/or masala chai.

                                                        Do not boil the potatoes (they absorb too much water) — microwave, steam or bake them. For vegan paratha, use oil instead of ghee.

                                                        Malai Aloo

                                                        https://sinfullyspicy.com/indian-potato-sabzi-malai-aloo-curry/

                                                        An indulgent, creamy potato curry cooked in ghee and finished with heavy cream — spicy and slightly tangy, with nutty, mellow mughlai korma–influenced flavours.

                                                        Main

                                                        • 8-10 potatoes (~400 g); Yukon gold preferred
                                                        • 1 small yellow onion, peeled & roughly chopped
                                                        • 3 garlic cloves
                                                        • 1-inch piece ginger
                                                        • 3 Thai green chillies or 1 serrano pepper (adjust to taste)
                                                        • 12 cashews
                                                        • 1/2 tsp white poppy seeds (khus khus)
                                                        • 4 tbsp ghee
                                                        • 5 green cardamom pods
                                                        • 1/2-inch cinnamon stick
                                                        • 1 tsp cumin powder
                                                        • 1.5 tsp coriander powder
                                                        • 1/4 tsp white pepper powder (optional)
                                                        • 1/3 cup plain whole yogurt, beaten
                                                        • 1/2 tsp sugar
                                                        • 1/2 tsp shahi jeera (caraway seeds)
                                                        • 1/3 cup heavy cream
                                                        • 1/8 tsp freshly ground nutmeg
                                                        • 1 tsp salt, or to taste

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Peel and cut the potatoes. Cover with salted water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and cook 8-10 minutes until about 90% cooked. Drain and keep nearby.
                                                        2. Soak the cashews and poppy seeds in warm water for 10 minutes.
                                                        3. Meanwhile blend the onion, green chillies, ginger and garlic into a smooth paste.
                                                        4. Warm the ghee in a pot; add the cinnamon and cardamom and stir 10-15 seconds. Add the onion paste and cook on low-medium until the raw smell is gone, without browning (to preserve the sauce colour).
                                                        5. Grind the soaked cashews and poppy seeds with a little water into a smooth paste (add water sparingly).
                                                        6. Add the potatoes to the onions; sprinkle over the powdered spices and stir to coat without browning.
                                                        7. Lower the heat (or take the pot off the stove) and add the beaten yogurt along with the cashew paste, stirring continuously so the yogurt warms through without curdling.
                                                        8. Add 1 to 1.5 cups warm water and the sugar; cover and simmer 10-12 minutes on low until the potatoes are cooked through.
                                                        9. Finish with freshly ground nutmeg, heavy cream and chopped cilantro; simmer 2-3 minutes more (do not boil). Serve warm.

                                                        Continuous stirring right after adding the yogurt prevents curdling. The sauce thickens as it sits — start with 1 cup water and adjust. Optional Punjabi touch: kasuri methi and garam masala at the end.

                                                        Chicken Biryani (Andy Hearnden)

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A layered chicken biryani with marinated chicken thighs, whole spices, saffron-milk optional finish, and a sealed-pot steam (dum) cook.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1 kg chicken thighs
                                                        • 500 g basmati rice
                                                        • 4 red onions, sliced
                                                        • 10 cloves garlic, crushed
                                                        • 2 knobs of ginger, finely grated
                                                        • 1 tbsp ground cumin
                                                        • 1 tbsp chilli powder
                                                        • 1 tsp turmeric
                                                        • 1 tbsp salt for chicken marinade
                                                        • 200 g yogurt
                                                        • 4 tomatoes, finely diced
                                                        • 2 green chillies, halved
                                                        • 3 tbsp ghee (reserve 1 tbsp for the final assembly)
                                                        • 1 cinnamon stick
                                                        • 4 green cardamom
                                                        • 1 tbsp coriander seeds
                                                        • 2 tbsp garam masala
                                                        • 1 bunch mint
                                                        • 1 bunch coriander

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Marinate the chicken in the yoghurt, turmeric, cumin, chilli powder and half of the garlic and ginger.
                                                        2. Wash the rice under cold water and leave to soak for 20 minutes.
                                                        3. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, add the rice, and cook for 6-7 minutes until about 2/3 cooked; then drain.
                                                        4. In a large pot, heat the ghee and flavour it with the cinnamon stick, green cardamom and coriander seeds. After a few minutes, add the onions and a tbsp of salt and sauté for 15-20 minutes, stirring often.
                                                        5. Remove a quarter of the cooked onions and set aside for the final assembly.
                                                        6. Add the remaining garlic and ginger to the pot and sauté for 2-3 minutes.
                                                        7. Add the marinated chicken, followed by the diced tomatoes, green chillies and garam masala.
                                                        8. Stir well and cook for 15-20 minutes or until the tomatoes are completely soft.
                                                        9. In a large pot with a lid, assemble the biryani: pour the remaining ghee in the bottom, then a layer of rice, then a layer of chicken, with a sprinkling of mint and coriander.
                                                        10. Repeat until all the rice and chicken are in the pot.
                                                        11. Make sure the last layer is rice on top with the reserved sautéed onions.
                                                        12. Optionally, warm 3 tbsp of milk with a pinch of saffron and pour over the assembled biryani.
                                                        13. Seal the pot by placing a tea towel under the lid and cook for 25 minutes on low.
                                                        14. Serve with more chopped mint and coriander and some crispy shallots (optional).

                                                        A trial-and-tested batter for soft, spongy idlis and crispy dosas (also works for dhokla and uttapam), fermented 12-15 hours in a cold climate.

                                                        • 4 cups rice (idli rice or any rice)
                                                        • 1 cup urad daal (gota or split urad daal)
                                                        • 1 tbsp fenugreek seeds (methi dana) — helps in fermentation
                                                        • Salt, as per taste (added only after fermentation)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Take a large bowl and add the rice, urad daal and fenugreek seeds to the same bowl.
                                                        2. Rinse the rice and daal under running water until the water turns clear. Keep aside to soak for 4-5 hours or overnight.
                                                        3. After 4-5 hours, drain the water and transfer to a blender. Add ice-cold water and grind to a fine paste consistency, adding more water as needed depending on the rice/dal.
                                                        4. Transfer the rice-daal paste to a large steel container and mix well (by hand or with a hand whisk). The consistency should be free-flowing but not runny.
                                                        5. Cover the container with foil paper and a lid. Place in an oven with the light on for 12-15 hours (especially in a cold place). In a very warm place, keep the batter on the counter to ferment for about 8 hours.
                                                        6. After 12-14 hours the batter should be well fermented — increased in volume, frothy and bubbly. Add salt as per taste. The batter is now ready to make idlis and dosas.

                                                        Fermentation tips from the caption: if using an Instant Pot, press the Yogurt button and set 12-15 hours (depends on climate). Do not add salt before fermentation. No need for poha.

                                                        Homemade Tikka Masala Sauce (Big-Batch Curry Base)

                                                        Transcribed from carveyourcraving.com (linked by creator)

                                                        Restaurant-style North Indian tikka masala curry base made in an Instant Pot or pressure cooker with under 30 minutes of active time. Vegan and gluten-free; makes a big batch and freezes well.

                                                        Sauce base

                                                        • 1/3 cup cooking oil
                                                        • 1/2 kg onions, roughly chopped (about 3)
                                                        • 1 kg tomatoes, roughly chopped (about 10 Roma)
                                                        • 10 big garlic cloves (or 2.5 tbsp grated)
                                                        • 1.5-inch piece fresh ginger, grated (or 2 tbsp paste)
                                                        • 1 cup raw broken cashews
                                                        • 1/3 cup white melon seeds
                                                        • 2 tbsp raisins
                                                        • 1/2 cup water

                                                        Whole spices

                                                        • 2 bay leaves
                                                        • 2 dried Kashmiri red chilies
                                                        • 2 stone flowers
                                                        • 2 star anise
                                                        • 1/2 tbsp fennel seeds (optional)

                                                        Ground spices

                                                        • 1/4 tsp hing (asafoetida)
                                                        • 1/2 tbsp cumin
                                                        • 1 tbsp red chili powder
                                                        • 2 tsp kitchen king or garam masala
                                                        • 1 tbsp coriander powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
                                                        • Salt to taste

                                                        After blending

                                                        • 1/2 tsp cardamom (elaichi) powder (optional)

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Switch on the Instant Pot on sauté mode; add the oil. When warm, add the hing and cumin, then the whole spices, onion, ginger, garlic and salt; stir for a minute.
                                                        2. Add the ground spices, cashews, melon seeds and raisins with 1/2 cup of water; stir and cook a minute. Add the tomatoes and a little more salt.
                                                        3. Close the lid and pressure cook on low for 8 minutes; release pressure and discard the bay leaf.
                                                        4. Blend with an immersion blender and pass through a fine-mesh sieve — or cool and blend in a high-speed blender — for a silky-smooth sauce.
                                                        5. Stir in the cardamom powder if using; taste and adjust seasoning.
                                                        6. Use as the base for chicken tikka masala, paneer tikka masala, chickpeas or vegetables. Finish with heavy cream or yogurt, crushed kasuri methi and chopped cilantro when serving.
                                                        7. Storage: refrigerates 4 days in an airtight container; freeze in portions (freeze before adding any dairy).

                                                        Garlic Ginger Steak Stir Fry

                                                        Transcribed from whatsgabycooking.com (linked by creator)

                                                        An under-30-minute weeknight dinner: crispy seared steak tossed in a glossy garlic-ginger butter sauce with a hit of sambal heat, served over rice.

                                                        Steak and marinade

                                                        • 2 1/2 lb flank or flat iron steak, cut into 1/4-inch strips
                                                        • 1 tsp kosher salt
                                                        • 1/2 tsp black pepper
                                                        • 1/4 cup soy sauce
                                                        • 1 tsp sesame oil
                                                        • 2 tbsp cornstarch

                                                        Stir-fry and sauce

                                                        • 1 tbsp canola oil
                                                        • 1 cup snow peas
                                                        • 1–2 bunches baby bok choy
                                                        • 4 tbsp unsalted butter
                                                        • 1 tbsp sambal
                                                        • 1/4 cup beef or chicken broth
                                                        • 4 large garlic cloves, minced
                                                        • 1–2 inch piece ginger, peeled and minced
                                                        • Green onions, thinly sliced (optional)
                                                        • Fresh parsley, chopped (optional)
                                                        • Rice, to serve

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Season the steak strips with salt and pepper.
                                                        2. In a medium bowl, mix the soy sauce, sesame oil and cornstarch until combined. Add the steak and toss until evenly coated; set aside.
                                                        3. Heat the canola oil in a large cast-iron skillet or wok over high heat. When the oil is smoking, add the steak in small batches to avoid crowding; cook 2–3 minutes per batch, stirring frequently, until slightly crispy. Remove and let the pan cool slightly.
                                                        4. Add the broth, butter, garlic, ginger and sambal to the pan over medium heat; bring the garlic-butter sauce to a simmer and cook 2–3 minutes until fragrant.
                                                        5. Add the bok choy and snow peas; cook 2 minutes.
                                                        6. Return the steak to the pan and toss everything together with the green onions and parsley. Serve warm as is or over steamed rice.

                                                        Chicken Malai Handi

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A quick, creamy chicken handi with a yogurt-and-cream white gravy, finished with fenugreek and garam masala.

                                                        Chicken malai handi

                                                        • 500 g boneless chicken
                                                        • 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
                                                        • 2–3 tbsp green chilli paste
                                                        • 1 tsp roasted coriander powder
                                                        • 1 tsp roasted cumin powder
                                                        • 1 tsp white pepper powder
                                                        • 1 tsp crushed black pepper
                                                        • 1 tsp salt, or to taste
                                                        • 3 tbsp butter or cooking oil
                                                        • 1/2 cup yogurt
                                                        • 1/2 cup cream
                                                        • Dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi)
                                                        • Garam masala powder

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. In a bowl, mix the boneless chicken with the ginger-garlic paste, green chilli paste, coriander powder, cumin powder, white pepper, black pepper and salt. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes to 1 hour.
                                                        2. Heat the butter in a pan; add the marinated chicken and mix well until it changes colour.
                                                        3. Add the yogurt, mix well, cover and cook on low to medium flame until the chicken is tender and the oil separates.
                                                        4. Stir in the cream and cook on medium flame for 2–3 minutes.
                                                        5. Add the fenugreek leaves and garam masala powder, mix and serve hot.

                                                        One-Pot Chicken Dinner

                                                        Transcribed from reel caption

                                                        A simple one-pot chicken dinner — a real crowd pleaser. 45 minutes, serves 6. A perfect back-to-routine weeknight classic.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                        • 1 red onion, finely chopped
                                                        • 2 carrots, finely chopped
                                                        • 2 sticks celery, finely chopped
                                                        • 500 g baby potatoes, halved
                                                        • 300 g mushrooms, halved
                                                        • 450 ml chicken stock
                                                        • 500 g chicken thighs, skinless and boneless
                                                        • Olive oil, for frying
                                                        • 25 g butter
                                                        • 1 tbsp plain flour
                                                        • Fresh thyme
                                                        • Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Season the chicken and fry in a high-sided pan in olive oil over high heat until brown on both sides. Remove to a plate and set aside.
                                                        2. Add the butter to the same pan and fry the onion, carrots and celery until soft.
                                                        3. Turn the heat to low; add the flour and stock, mixing well. Turn the heat back up to a steady simmer and let the sauce thicken.
                                                        4. When thickened, add the chicken, potatoes and mushrooms to the pot. Add water to cover the chicken and potatoes if needed.
                                                        5. Bring to a boil, cover with a lid and cook until the potatoes are tender and the chicken is cooked through.
                                                        6. Sprinkle with finely cut chives and serve.

                                                        Creamy Baked Pesto Pasta with Chicken Meatballs

                                                        Transcribed from healthyishfoods.com — 'Creamy Baked Pesto Pasta with Chicken Meatballs'

                                                        A gourmet-but-simple weeknight meal: juicy chicken meatballs nestled into creamy pesto pasta, baked with melty mozzarella. Leftovers reheat beautifully.

                                                        Pasta and Sauce

                                                        • 8 oz pasta, cooked al dente
                                                        • 2 tbsp butter
                                                        • 1/2 cup shallots, diced small
                                                        • 1 tbsp garlic, minced (2-3 cloves)
                                                        • 1/4 cup pesto (store-bought is fine)
                                                        • 1/2 - 3/4 cup pasta water
                                                        • 4 oz cream cheese
                                                        • 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
                                                        • Cracked black pepper, to taste
                                                        • Pinch of red pepper flakes, to taste
                                                        • 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella, for the top
                                                        • Fresh basil, as garnish

                                                        Chicken Meatballs

                                                        • 1 lb ground chicken
                                                        • 1 large egg
                                                        • 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
                                                        • 1/2 cup Italian breadcrumbs
                                                        • 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese
                                                        • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp onion powder
                                                        • 1/2 tsp dried oregano
                                                        • 1/2 tsp kosher salt
                                                        • 1/4 tsp dried parsley
                                                        • 1/4 tsp cracked black pepper
                                                        • 1/4 - 1/2 cup avocado oil (or vegetable oil) for pan frying

                                                        Steps

                                                        1. Preheat the oven to 375 F. Boil the pasta al dente; reserve about 1 cup of pasta water, then drain and set aside.
                                                        2. In a mixing bowl, combine the ground chicken, egg, olive oil, breadcrumbs, parmesan, oregano, parsley, onion powder, garlic powder, kosher salt and black pepper. Mix until well combined and form into meatballs (about 25).
                                                        3. Shallow-fry the meatballs in avocado oil over medium-high heat until golden brown on all sides; drain on paper towels. Tip: wet your hands with water before rolling so the meat doesn't stick.
                                                        4. In a 3.5-quart oven-safe saucepan over medium-high heat, melt the butter and saute the shallots until soft. Add the garlic until fragrant, then stir in the pesto and 1/2-3/4 cup pasta water.
                                                        5. Whisk in the cream cheese until smooth (add more pasta water if the sauce gets too thick); turn off the heat. Option: add 3/4 cup heavy cream for a creamier sauce.
                                                        6. Add the cooked pasta to the sauce, toss with the grated parmesan, nestle in the meatballs, and top with the mozzarella, red pepper flakes, cracked black pepper and parsley.
                                                        7. Cover and bake 15-20 minutes, until the meatballs reach 165 F inside. Garnish with fresh basil and serve hot.

                                                        • 1 tsp cumin seeds, lightly toasted
                                                        • 7-8 cloves garlic
                                                        • 5-6 shallots
                                                        • 2 inches chopped galangal
                                                        • 1 tsp white peppercorns

                                                        • Kaffir lime skin of 1 lemon

                                                        For the Curry

                                                        • Veggies of your choice (Thai eggplant, mushrooms, zucchini, broccoli, bell pepper)
                                                        • Salt to taste
                                                        • 1 tsp brown sugar
                                                        • A bunch of Thai basil leaves
                                                        • Sliced red chilli
                                                        • 3-4 shredded kaffir lime leaves

                                                        Steps

                                                        Unbelievable 10-Minute Chocolate Pudding

                                                        From the creator's website: https://bakewithzoha.com/unbelievable-ten-minute-chocolate-pudding/

                                                        One pan, no mixer, no eggs — a rich, decadent, creamy chocolate pudding with a molten-chocolate-silk texture. Makes 4 servings.

                                                        Ingredients

                                                          Steps

                                                          1. Add all ingredients to a large nonstick saucepan.
                                                          2. Place on low heat and whisk gently; cook until the butter and chocolate melt and everything combines (it looks strange and lumpy at first but comes together as it cooks).
                                                          3. Keep cooking and stirring on low until the pudding comes to a boil; it thickens quickly after this point. Cook to a thick custard-like consistency (thick but still pourable), about 8–10 minutes total. Remove from the heat.
                                                          4. Strain the pudding to remove any lumps; pour into serving cups or a dish.
                                                          5. Serve warm right away, or refrigerate 2–4 hours for a chilled semi-set pudding.
                                                          6. Optionally garnish with fresh berries and/or chocolate shavings. Serve and enjoy.

                                                          Use good-quality chocolate bars or callets (not chips). Use the higher end of the chocolate range for a richer pudding. Keep the heat low and stir constantly — the cornstarch thickens fast once it simmers.

                                                                            (High Protein) Italian Wedding Soup

                                                                            https://abrightmoment.com/high-protein-italian-wedding-soup/

                                                                            A high-protein take on the cozy classic: seared mini meatballs simmered with orzo, spinach and chicken bone broth. Prep 20 minutes, cook 20 minutes, serves 8.

                                                                            Meatballs

                                                                            • 1 lb ground beef
                                                                            • 2 Italian pork sausage links, casings removed
                                                                            • 3/4 cup panko breadcrumbs
                                                                            • 2 eggs
                                                                            • 1/2 cup grated parmesan
                                                                            • 1/4 cup fresh parsley
                                                                            • 1 tsp each garlic powder, salt & black pepper

                                                                            Soup

                                                                            • 4 tbsp olive oil
                                                                            • 1/2 yellow onion, chopped
                                                                            • 3 celery stalks, finely chopped
                                                                            • 3 carrots, finely chopped
                                                                            • 6 garlic cloves, minced or sliced
                                                                            • 1/3 cup white wine
                                                                            • 6 cups chicken bone broth
                                                                            • 3/4 cup orzo pasta, uncooked
                                                                            • 2 cups spinach
                                                                            • 2 bay leaves (optional)

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, sausage, breadcrumbs, eggs, parmesan, parsley, garlic powder, salt and black pepper; mix until very well combined.
                                                                            2. Roll about one tablespoon of the mixture per meatball in the palms of your hands.
                                                                            3. In a large skillet over medium-high heat with a generous drizzle of olive oil, sear the mini meatballs until browned on all sides; set aside.
                                                                            4. In a large soup pot over medium-high heat with another generous drizzle of olive oil, add the onion, carrot, celery and garlic; sauté 4–5 minutes until fragrant and tender.
                                                                            5. Stir in the uncooked orzo pasta.
                                                                            6. Deglaze the pot with the white wine, stirring until evaporated.
                                                                            7. Add the chicken broth, bay leaves (if using), mini meatballs and spinach. Bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
                                                                            8. Serve warm with freshly grated parmesan on top.

                                                                            Crockpot Chicken and Gravy

                                                                            https://www.thereciperebel.com/crockpot-chicken-and-gravy/

                                                                            A cozy family-favorite dinner with fall-apart tender chicken and real homemade gravy — no condensed soups or gravy packets. Ten minutes of prep, then the slow cooker does the rest.

                                                                            Ingredients

                                                                            • 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts
                                                                            • 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs
                                                                            • 1 1/2 cups low-sodium chicken broth
                                                                            • 2 tbsp corn starch
                                                                            • 1 tsp salt
                                                                            • 1 tsp Italian seasoning
                                                                            • 1/2 tsp onion powder
                                                                            • 1/2 tsp garlic powder
                                                                            • 1/4 tsp black pepper
                                                                            • 1/4 cup heavy whipping cream (optional)

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Place the chicken breasts and thighs in a 3–6 quart slow cooker.
                                                                            2. In a large glass measuring cup, whisk together the broth, corn starch, salt, Italian seasoning, onion powder, garlic powder and pepper until the corn starch is completely dissolved. Pour over the chicken.
                                                                            3. Cover and cook on low for about 3 hours, until a meat thermometer in the thickest piece reads 165°F (time varies with slow cooker size and fullness).
                                                                            4. Remove the chicken to a cutting board and pull or shred into pieces.
                                                                            5. Stir the gravy to combine (strain through a fine mesh sieve if desired for extra smoothness), then stir in the cream if using. Taste and adjust seasonings.
                                                                            6. Serve the chicken with the gravy spooned over — great with mashed potatoes or crusty bread.

                                                                            Leftovers keep 3–4 days refrigerated or up to 3 months frozen; reheat gently on the stovetop. Gravy too thin? Cook on high with the lid off a few minutes. Too thick? Whisk in a splash of broth or milk.

                                                                            • Coriander, to garnish
                                                                            • Roti or paratha

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Marinate the chicken with the lime juice, salt, pepper, chilli powder, coriander powder and ginger garlic paste.
                                                                            2. Line a tray with parchment paper, arrange the marinated chicken pieces on it and drizzle with oil.
                                                                            3. Air fry at 230°C for about 15 minutes, until cooked through and crispy.
                                                                            4. In a pan, heat the ghee and add the mustard seeds, slit green chillies, curry leaves, red chilli powder and turmeric; cook until it starts crackling.
                                                                            5. Pour the hot tadka over the Greek yogurt and stir well.
                                                                            6. Add the air-fried chicken pieces, pour over the yogurt and mix everything well.
                                                                            7. Garnish with chopped coriander and sliced onions; serve with roti or paratha of choice.

                                                                            Restaurant-Worthy Guacamole

                                                                            https://playswellwithbutter.com/best-guacamole-recipe-ever/

                                                                            Chunky-creamy guac with a secret ingredient: Tajín. Ready in 15 minutes; serves 6.

                                                                            Ingredients

                                                                            • 2 large ripe Hass avocados, halved and de-seeded
                                                                            • 1/4 medium red onion, finely diced (approx. 1/4 cup)
                                                                            • 2 jalapeño peppers, de-seeded as desired and finely diced
                                                                            • 2 cloves garlic, roughly chopped
                                                                            • 1 large juicy lime, juiced (approx. 3 tbsp)
                                                                            • 1/3 cup finely chopped cilantro
                                                                            • 1 tsp kosher salt
                                                                            • Heaping 1/2 tsp garlic powder
                                                                            • Heaping 1/2 tsp chile lime seasoning (such as Tajín)
                                                                            • For serving: finely chopped cilantro, tortilla chips, etc.

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Smash the aromatics: add the onion, jalapeño and garlic to a resealable bag with a pinch of salt. Seal, pressing out the air, and smash with a rolling pin or heavy pan until juicy and softened but not a paste. (Or use a molcajete.)
                                                                            2. Mix: scoop the avocado flesh into a large bowl; add the smashed vegetables and all remaining ingredients (lime juice through Tajín). Smash gently with a spoon to your desired consistency and stir to combine. Taste and adjust salt/lime.
                                                                            3. Serve immediately with tortilla chips, topped with extra cilantro and Tajín.

                                                                            Crispy Baked Chicken with Roasted Pepper Sauce

                                                                            Transcribed from reel caption

                                                                            Makes 2 servings (467 kcal, 50 g protein per serving); sauce makes about 4 servings (140 kcal).

                                                                            Chicken

                                                                            • 450 g (about 4 pieces) boneless skinless chicken thigh

                                                                            Marinade

                                                                            • 1/2 cup curd/Greek yoghurt
                                                                            • 2 tsp garlic paste
                                                                            • 2 tsp peri peri seasoning
                                                                            • 1 tsp chilli flakes
                                                                            • 1 egg
                                                                            • Salt to taste

                                                                            Crumb

                                                                            • 1/2 cup panko bread crumbs
                                                                            • 2 tbsp cornflour
                                                                            • 1 tsp peri peri seasoning
                                                                            • 1 tsp chilli flakes
                                                                            • Salt to taste
                                                                            • Pinch of Aromat powder (optional)

                                                                            Sauce

                                                                            • 1/2 red bell pepper, lightly roasted
                                                                            • 3–4 garlic cloves (optionally lightly cooked)
                                                                            • 30 g paneer
                                                                            • 1/3 cup skim milk
                                                                            • 1 tbsp broken cashewnuts
                                                                            • 1 tsp peri peri seasoning
                                                                            • 1 tsp chilli flakes
                                                                            • Salt to taste

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Brine the chicken in salted water a few hours or overnight in the fridge.
                                                                            2. Whisk the marinade ingredients; marinate the chicken at least 1–2 hours.
                                                                            3. Mix the crumb ingredients; coat the chicken thighs on both sides.
                                                                            4. Place on a greased baking tray, brush with oil; bake at 200°C for 15 minutes, then switch to top heat/grill for 5 minutes. (Air fryer: 200°C for 10 minutes, flip, 10–12 minutes more.)
                                                                            5. Rest 5–10 minutes.
                                                                            6. Blend all sauce ingredients; season as needed.
                                                                            7. Serve the chicken with the sauce.

                                                                            • Finely chopped curry leaves and coriander leaves

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Rinse and soak the black urad and rice together for 2 hours (no longer).
                                                                            2. Grind with ginger, pepper and cumin, then add hing and salt; use water as needed for a coarse yet spreadable batter.
                                                                            3. Stir in the chopped onions, curry leaves and coriander leaves.

                                                                            One-Dish Butter Chicken Pie

                                                                            Transcribed from reel caption

                                                                            510 Cal | 53g protein | 30g carbs | 19g fat per pie. Serves 4, made in 2 1/2-cup (600 ml) glass containers.

                                                                            Ingredients

                                                                            • 7 oz (200 g) puff pastry (1 serving per pie)

                                                                            Butter Chicken Base Sauce

                                                                            • 1 1/2 cups protein boosted milk (Vitasoy)
                                                                            • 3/4 cup (250 g) Greek yogurt
                                                                            • 6 tbsp (170 g) tomato paste

                                                                            Butter Chicken Sauce Spices

                                                                            • Use your favorite packet of butter chicken paste, or the homemade mix: 2 tbsp (12 g) curry powder, 1 tbsp (6 g) garam masala, 1 tbsp (6 g) ground cumin, 2 tsp ground ginger, 2 tsp garlic powder, 1.5 tsp salt, 1 tsp turmeric

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
                                                                            2. In a large bowl, whisk together the butter chicken base sauce and spices.
                                                                            3. Add diced raw chicken to oven-safe containers; divide the milk mixture evenly among them.
                                                                            4. Top each container with a square of puff pastry; cut a small slit in the top for steam. Brush pastry with beaten egg.
                                                                            5. Place containers on a baking sheet and bake 25–30 minutes, until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is bubbling (chicken internal temp 165°F/74°C).
                                                                            6. Let stand 5 minutes before serving. Caution: containers will be hot.

                                                                            For the chocolate chip dough

                                                                            • 1 1/2 cups (190 g) all-purpose flour
                                                                            • 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
                                                                            • 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt
                                                                            • 3/4 cup (128 g) semisweet chocolate wafers or feves

                                                                            For the cocoa dough

                                                                            • 1 1/4 cups plus 2 tablespoons (175 g) all-purpose flour
                                                                            • 1/4 cup (21 g) unsweetened natural cocoa powder
                                                                            • 1/2 teaspoon baking soda
                                                                            • 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt
                                                                            • 1/4 teaspoon instant espresso powder, optional
                                                                            • 3/4 cup (128 g) semisweet chocolate wafers or feves
                                                                            • Flaky sea salt, for finishing, if desired

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
                                                                            2. Beat the butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar until creamy, about 3 minutes. Add vanilla and eggs; beat until combined.
                                                                            3. Whisk the chocolate chip dough dry ingredients; add half the creamed butter-sugar mixture (about 330 g) and stir into a cohesive dough. Mix in the chocolate wafers, reserving some for garnish.
                                                                            4. To the remaining butter-sugar mixture add the cocoa dough dry ingredients; beat on low to combine. Mix in the chocolate wafers, reserving some for garnish.
                                                                            5. Scoop portions of both doughs with a 1 1/2-tablespoon scoop. Tear one ball in half and sandwich the other dough ball inside (or vice versa); roll between palms. Place on the baking sheet and dot with reserved wafers.
                                                                            6. If time permits, refrigerate the shaped dough 24–72 hours for thicker, chewier, more flavorful cookies.
                                                                            7. Bake 11–13 minutes, until golden at the edges. Sprinkle with flaky sea salt if desired. Cool 5 minutes, then transfer to wire racks.
                                                                            View reel

                                                                            Moelleux au Chocolat (Melt in the Middle Chocolate Cake)

                                                                            https://desertislanddishes.co/moelleux-au-chocolat/

                                                                            A giant melt-in-the-middle chocolate cake — rich, gooey and decadent, especially served warm. Naturally gluten free, just 5 ingredients.

                                                                            For the cake

                                                                            • 1 cup unsalted butter (2 sticks), cut into cubes, plus extra for greasing
                                                                            • 8 oz good-quality 70% dark chocolate, roughly chopped (about 1 cup)
                                                                            • 2.6 oz cocoa powder (about 3/4 cup)
                                                                            • Pinch of salt
                                                                            • 7 large eggs
                                                                            • 9.3 oz superfine (caster) sugar (about 1 1/3 cups), divided

                                                                            To serve

                                                                            • Heavy (double) cream, or ice cream, or custard

                                                                            Steps

                                                                            1. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C/180°C fan). Generously butter a 9-inch (23 cm) round springform pan and line the base with parchment paper.
                                                                            2. Melt the butter and chocolate together in a heatproof bowl over simmering water (or microwave in 30-second bursts), stirring until smooth.
                                                                            3. Sift in the cocoa powder and salt; stir until smooth. Set aside.
                                                                            4. Separate the eggs. Add about 4 3/4 oz (135 g) of the sugar to the yolks and whisk until pale, light and thick.
                                                                            5. Whisk the egg whites to soft peaks, gradually adding the remaining sugar, until stiff and glossy.
                                                                            6. Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the egg yolks and stir gently. Stir in 2 spoonfuls of whisked egg whites vigorously (the "sacrificial" spoon), then gently fold in the remaining whites.
                                                                            7. Pour 2/3 of the batter into the prepared pan and bake about 25 minutes, until well risen and a skewer comes out clean. Leave to cool completely in the pan (it may collapse — that is normal).
                                                                            8. Keep the remaining 1/3 of batter in the fridge.
                                                                            9. Once the cake is cool, remove from the pan, place on a lined baking sheet and spread the reserved batter on top.
                                                                            10. Bake again 10–15 minutes, until a thin crust forms but the middle is still soft and jiggly. Rest 10 minutes.
                                                                            11. Slice and serve warm with cream, ice cream or custard (or chilled from the fridge).
